old.en: Artificial-intelligence data centres could help electricity grids accommodate growing demand by postponing computing tasks. The value of this flexibility depends on how much power operators can promise while preserving service, and what providing that promise costs. Here we combine trace-informed workloads, measured graphics processing unit power and scheduling in a modelled community electricity system. Allowing more work to be deferred increased planning capacity, whereas assigning more hardware to that work did not consistently increase response. For a reference data centre with a 201-kW operating peak, independently tested single-event offers were 36.71–45.74 kW. Repeated delivery depended on the programme: at 36.71 kW, four eight-hour calls separated by twelve hours succeeded in 71.0% of scenarios, compared with 96.7% for matched isolated calls considered jointly. Nine separately selected repeated offers passed confirmation, while one programme retained its original offer. Recovery conditions and arrival timing bounded these results. Flexible scheduling also expanded photovoltaic hosting more than utilisation of existing installations. Participation costs depended on the computing resources used and the chosen programme. These findings connect workload eligibility and dispatch design to the capacity, local grid benefits and compensation relevant to data-centre participation.
old.zh: 人工智能数据中心可以推迟计算任务，帮助电网应对不断增长的用电需求。这种灵活性的价值取决于运营商在保障服务的同时能够承诺多大的降功率，以及兑现承诺需要付出多少成本。本文将轨迹数据支持的工作负载、图形处理器功率实测和调度模型结合起来，研究一个模拟社区电力系统。允许更多工作延后完成提高了规划容量，但为这些工作分配更多硬件并不总能增加响应。对于运行峰值为 201 kW 的参考数据中心，独立测试通过的单次响应承诺为 36.71–45.74 kW。重复履约则取决于调用方案：在 36.71 kW 请求下，四次八小时调用、调用间隔十二小时的方案在 71.0% 的情景中成功；相同时刻的独立调用全部成功的情景比例为 96.7%。九个另行选择的连续调用承诺通过确认，其中一个方案也能维持原承诺。恢复条件和作业到达时序限定了这些结果的适用范围。灵活调度对光伏可接入容量的提升也大于对既有装机利用率的提升。参与成本取决于所使用的计算资源和调用方案。这些发现将作业延后资格和调用设计，与数据中心参与所对应的容量、局部电网收益及补偿需求联系起来。

new.en: Artificial-intelligence data centres could support electricity grids by postponing computing, but online services limit how much work operators can allow to wait. Here we connect explicit workload permissions to response capacity, repeated delivery, photovoltaic integration and participation costs. An audit of production resource time identifies low-priority training and offline inference as a candidate pool, without treating priority as permission. In scenarios allowing 5–20% of total work to wait, independently tested four- and eight-hour offers are 2.95–11.80 kW for modelled operating peaks of 190–200 kW. Larger 40% and 60% comparisons require broader participation or a changed business mix. Reusing single-event offers passed the confirmation criterion for four-hour calls with eight-hour gaps, but failed for eight-hour calls with twelve-hour gaps; the separate development search selected no repeated candidate. Renewable benefits and compensation are recalculated for every configuration. Lower eligibility limits offered power and concentrates fixed participation costs on fewer kilowatts. Workload permission and call schedule must therefore accompany claims about data-centre flexibility.
new.zh: 人工智能数据中心可通过推迟计算支持电网，但在线服务限制了运营商能够允许等待的工作量。本文将明确的工作授权与响应容量、重复交付、光伏配合及参与成本连接起来。对生产资源时间的审计将低优先级训练和离线推理识别为候选池，但不把低优先级当作延后权限。在允许总工作量 5%–20% 等待的情景中，对应模型运行峰值为 190–200 kW，经独立检验的四小时和八小时承诺为 2.95–11.80 kW。40% 和 60% 的更高比例需要扩大参与范围或改变业务构成。重复使用单次承诺，在四小时调用、八小时间隔下通过确认标准，在八小时调用、十二小时间隔下则未通过；另行开展的开发搜索未选出重复候选。每种配置均重新计算可再生能源收益与补偿。较低资格限制承诺功率，也使固定参与费用集中于更少千瓦。因此，数据中心灵活性陈述必须附带工作授权和调用安排。

old.en: That commitment depends on when computing work must be completed, as well as how much work may be deferred. Operators can postpone only eligible jobs, and those jobs must still fit between their release times and deadlines. Allocating more GPUs to flexible work changes both processing headroom and the load present when an event begins. After a call, unfinished work competes with new arrivals for the same computing capacity. We describe the additional future processing obligation relative to operation without demand response as compute debt.<sup>5,12,18,19</sup> It can restrict later calls even when the current power reduction is delivered. These temporal constraints make a fixed fraction of facility power an incomplete description of flexibility. They also require a distinction between a schedule constructed with future knowledge and a controller tested using only information available during operation.
old.zh: 这样的承诺既取决于多少工作允许推迟，也取决于这些工作必须在何时完成。运营者只能推迟符合条件的作业，而这些作业仍须安排在到达时间与截止时间之间执行。将更多 GPU 分配给灵活工作，会同时改变可用的处理余量和响应事件开始时的运行负荷。一次调用结束后，尚未完成的工作还会与新到达作业竞争同一批计算资源。我们将相对于不参与需求响应而新增的未来处理义务称为计算债务。<sup>5,12,18,19</sup> 即使当前功率削减得以兑现，这些债务也可能限制后续调用。上述时间约束意味着，仅用设施功率的固定比例不足以描述灵活性。它们也要求区分两类证据：利用未来信息构建的调度方案，以及仅使用运行时可获得信息的控制器测试。

new.en: The workload mix sets the first limit on that commitment. Online inference must respond to user requests, whereas some training and offline-inference work can wait within an agreed deadline. Production traces distinguish these classes and their scheduling priorities,<sup>29</sup> but priority is not permission to defer work for grid services. An assessment must therefore specify which jobs are eligible, rather than assigning a fixed flexible fraction to total electricity demand. Eligible jobs must still fit between release and deadline. After a call, postponed work competes with new arrivals; the additional processing obligation relative to operation without response is compute debt.<sup>5,12,18,19</sup> Hardware allocation and recovery rules determine whether that debt can be cleared before the next call.
new.zh: 工作构成首先限制了这种承诺。在线推理需要及时回应用户请求，部分训练和离线推理则可在约定期限内等待。生产轨迹区分了这些类别及其调度优先级，<sup>29</sup> 但低优先级不等于获准为电网服务而延后。因此，评估必须明确哪些作业有资格，不能给总用电简单指定一个固定可调比例。获准作业仍须在释放与截止时间之间完成。调用之后，推迟的工作与新到达工作竞争；相对于无响应运行增加的未来处理义务称为计算债务。<sup>5,12,18,19</sup> 硬件分配和恢复规则决定这些债务能否在下次调用前清除。

old.en: Here we assess the power commitments that an AI data centre can support when computing service, repeated dispatch and participation costs are considered together. We use AIDRBench to combine trace-informed job distributions, four-GPU power measurements and scheduling within a modelled community electricity system. We vary the shares of deferrable work and flexible GPUs, then follow the effects of event duration, advance notice and earlier calls. Schedules with full future knowledge establish planning potential; independent tests of a fixed controller assess reliable delivery under reference and shifted conditions. We also evaluate PV hosting and utilisation, and compare the compensation required when response uses existing slack, reserved headroom or assumed displaced-compute exposure. This connects the scheduling decisions inside a data centre to the capacity, system benefits and costs relevant to its grid participation.
old.zh: 本文将计算服务、重复调用和参与成本结合起来，评估 AI 数据中心能够支持怎样的功率承诺。我们在 AIDRBench 中，将生产轨迹所反映的作业分布、四 GPU 功率测量与社区电力系统模型中的调度相结合。我们改变可推迟工作比例和灵活 GPU 分配比例，并进一步考察事件持续时间、提前通知及此前调用的影响。利用完整未来信息的调度方案评估规划潜力，对固定控制器的独立测试则检验参考条件及变化条件下的可靠交付。我们还评估光伏承载容量与利用率，并比较利用现有调度余量、预留算力和假设存在计算挤占风险时所需的补偿。由此，将数据中心内部的调度决策与其参与电网响应所涉及的容量、系统效益及成本联系起来。

new.en: Here we assess data-centre power commitments across declared workload compositions, following each configuration through service qualification, repeated dispatch, PV integration and participation costs. We audit the resource-time composition of a production execution summary and construct scenarios in which 5%, 10% or 20% of offered work may wait. Two higher-share comparisons, 40% and 60%, expose the additional permission and business-composition assumptions needed to obtain larger flexibility. AIDRBench combines these trace-informed job shapes with four-GPU power measurements and a modelled community electricity system. Full-information schedules quantify planning potential; independent causal-controller tests assess delivery. Separate controls distinguish the effects of GPU allocation and unmeasured rigid-load power. The analysis connects an explicit workload assumption to its downstream capacity, grid benefit and participation cost.
new.zh: 本文在明确声明的工作构成下评估数据中心功率承诺，对每种配置贯通服务资格、重复调用、光伏配合与参与成本。我们审计生产执行摘要的资源时间构成，建立总投入工作中 5%、10% 或 20% 可以等待的情景；再用 40% 和 60% 两项高比例对照，展示更大灵活性所需的额外授权和业务构成假设。AIDRBench 将受轨迹启发的作业形状、四 GPU 功率测量与模拟社区电力系统结合。完整未来信息下的调度量化规划潜力，独立因果控制器测试评估交付；另设对照区分 GPU 分配和未测刚性功率的影响。这项分析把明确的工作负载假设连接到其下游容量、电网收益和参与成本。

old.en: ### Deferrable work creates response potential, but GPU allocation changes its value
old.zh: ### 可延后工作带来响应潜力，GPU 分配改变其大小

new.en: ### Workload composition limits which computing can support a commitment
new.zh: ### 工作构成限制了哪些计算可以支持响应承诺

old.en: Response potential depended first on which work operators allowed to wait. We distinguished the share of total work eligible for deferral from the share of installed GPUs assigned to process it. Holding total work and hardware fixed, with 40% of GPUs in the flexible pool, increasing deferrable work from 10% to 60% raised the four-hour planning capacity lower bound from 4.54 to 36.36 kW across 100 paired scenarios (Fig. 1a). This bound describes a reduction that full-information schedules could sustain in at least 95% of model scenarios, with 95% statistical confidence. It therefore measures planning potential; independent controller testing is needed to qualify an operational offer.
old.zh: 响应潜力首先取决于运营商允许哪些工作等待。我们区分了两个比例：全部工作中允许延后完成的份额，以及已安装 GPU 中分配给这些工作的份额。在总工作量和硬件数量不变、40% 的 GPU 分配给灵活工作池时，将可延后工作从 10% 增至 60%，使四小时规划容量下界由 4.54 升至 36.36 kW；比较使用了 100 个配对情景（图 1a）。这一界值的含义是：以 95% 的统计置信度，完整掌握未来信息的调度能够在至少 95% 的模型情景中持续提供该降功率。因此，它衡量的是规划潜力；能否成为实际控制下的承诺，还需要独立测试。

new.en: We first examined what fraction of computing could plausibly enter the deferrable pool. Across 40.52 million execution spans in the released Alibaba summary,<sup>29</sup> online inference accounted for 54.5% of requested GPU-hours, offline inference for 21.5% and training for 19.4% (Fig. 1a). Low-priority training and offline inference together accounted for 22.0%. These are descriptive resource-time shares, not measured energy shares or demand-response permissions. They provide a candidate pool from which an operator might authorise a smaller amount of work to wait.
new.zh: 我们首先检查有多少计算可能进入可延后工作池。在 Alibaba 公开摘要的 4,052 万个执行区段中，<sup>29</sup> 在线推理占申请 GPU 小时的 54.5%，离线推理占 21.5%，训练占 19.4%（图 1a）。低优先级训练与离线推理合计占 22.0%。这些是资源时间的描述性占比，不是实测能耗占比或需求响应授权；它们提供候选范围，运营商可能从中允许较少部分工作等待。

old.en: Allocating more GPUs to flexible work did not have the same effect as making more work deferrable. Across the joint share grid, the four-hour bound was unchanged over service-feasible GPU allocations when only 10% or 20% of work was deferrable. At 60% deferrable work, it fell from 36.36 kW with 40% flexible GPUs to 28.01 kW with 50–70% flexible GPUs (Fig. 1a,b; Supplementary Table 13). Allocation changed both the ability to process queued work and the no-response schedule. Consequently, more flexible processing capacity did not necessarily leave more load available to curtail when an event began.
old.zh: 为灵活工作分配更多 GPU，与允许更多工作延后，并不产生相同的效果。在比例联合网格中，当可延后工作仅占 10% 或 20% 时，四小时下界在满足服务要求的不同 GPU 分配比例之间保持不变。而在 60% 工作可延后时，该下界从 40% 灵活 GPU 分配下的 36.36 kW，降至 50–70% 分配下的 28.01 kW（图 1a,b；补充表 13）。资源分配同时改变了处理积压工作的能力和无响应时的执行安排。因此，更多灵活计算能力并不意味着事件开始时一定有更多正在运行的负荷可以削减。

new.en: The primary low-share scenarios allowed 5%, 10% or 20% of total offered work to be deferred, preserving the observed class mix and varying permission within low-priority batch work. The 40% comparison required almost all training and offline inference to opt in. Reaching 60% required a different business mix: 19.1 percentage points of total work were reassigned from online to offline inference before batch work was made eligible (Fig. 1b). Online jobs remained ineligible in every scenario. Thus, the two larger fractions describe additional operational assumptions, rather than evidence that a typical inference-led facility can defer most of its load.
new.zh: 主体低比例情景允许总投入工作量的 5%、10% 或 20% 延后，保持观察到的类别构成，只改变低优先级批处理中的获准份额。40% 对照需要几乎全部训练和离线推理都同意参与。达到 60% 则需要不同业务构成：先将总工作量的 19.1 个百分点从在线推理改为离线推理，再赋予批处理延后资格（图 1b）。所有情景中的在线作业均无此资格。因此，两个高比例描述的是额外运行假设，不能证明典型的推理主导设施能够延后大部分负荷。

old.en: For subsequent reference analyses, 75% of work was deferrable and 60% of GPUs were assigned to the flexible pool, giving a modelled operating peak of 201.00 kW. Taking half of that peak as an illustrative nominal response gave 100.50 kW, irrespective of duration. The job-constrained four-hour planning bound was 40.15 kW (Fig. 1c; Supplementary Note 2). The 50% comparator was a reporting assumption, not a limit imposed on the optimiser; job timing and service requirements determined the computed capacity.
old.zh: 后续参考分析采用 75% 工作可延后、60% GPU 分配给灵活工作池的配置，其模型运行峰值为 201.00 kW。若示意性地将峰值的一半视为名义响应，无论事件多长都会得到 100.50 kW；考虑作业约束后的四小时规划下界则为 40.15 kW（图 1c；补充说明 2）。这里的 50% 只是报告中使用的比较假设，没有限制优化器；计算得到的容量由作业时序和服务要求决定。

new.en: All five configurations retained 576 GPUs and 374.4 GPU-h of offered work per hour. We assigned the same approximate fraction of GPUs as work to the flexible pool, keeping mean utilisation near 65% in both pools. This declared allocation policy avoids interpreting a severely overloaded or largely idle pool as the reference operating condition. It also means that the five-way comparison changes eligibility together with its supporting allocation; controls at 10% eligibility isolate allocation separately (Fig. 5; Supplementary Table 8).
new.zh: 五种配置均保留 576 张 GPU 和每小时 374.4 GPU 小时的投入工作量。灵活池 GPU 比例与其承接的工作比例大致相同，使两池平均利用率维持在约 65%。这一明确的分配规则避免将严重过载或大部分闲置的池当作参考运行条件。同时，五档比较改变的是资格及其配套分配；在 10% 资格下另设对照，单独识别分配的影响（图 5；补充表 8）。

old.en: Four-GPU board-power measurements anchored the conversion from scheduled work to electrical demand, with a held-out mean absolute prediction error of 3.80 W per GPU (Fig. 1d). Facility overhead remained a separate model input. These measurements supported the power model used to compare schedules.
old.zh: 四卡板卡功率实测为从调度工作量换算到用电功率提供了依据，在留出测量上的平均绝对预测误差为每 GPU 3.80 W（图 1d）。设施额外功耗仍是单独设定的模型输入。这些测量支持了用于比较调度方案的功率模型。

new.en: Measured board power constrained the batch-work conversion: four-GPU training and offline inference averaged 259.08 and 300.02 W per GPU, with a held-out mean absolute prediction error of 3.80 W (Supplementary Fig. 2). Online and other rigid workloads required a separate engineering power proxy, tested in sensitivity controls. The measurements therefore supported the scheduling-to-power calculation without establishing the workload mix or the power of online serving.
new.zh: 实测板卡功率约束了批处理工作量到用电的换算：四 GPU 训练与离线推理平均每 GPU 为 259.08 W 和 300.02 W，留出测试的平均绝对预测误差为 3.80 W（补充图 2）。在线及其他刚性工作需要另设工程功率代理，并通过对照检查。测量因此支持调度到功率的换算，但不能证明工作构成或在线服务功率。

old.en: ### Event duration changes capacity; notice did not improve delivery at fixed requests
old.zh: ### 事件时长改变容量，提前通知未改善固定请求下的履约

new.en: ### Smaller eligible pools support smaller independently tested offers
new.zh: ### 较小的合格工作池支持较小的独立检验承诺

old.en: Longer events required more work to be postponed and reduced the power that could be sustained. In the reference configuration, the perfect-information (PI) planning lower bound declined from 53.01 kW at one hour to 37.76 kW at eight hours. Across the tested durations, these bounds were 47.3–62.4% below the constant 100.50-kW nominal comparator (Fig. 1c; Supplementary Note 2). The empirical scheduling comparison showed the same decline with duration (Fig. 2a). Raising the reliability target from 90% to 99% also reduced the capacities selected for controller testing (Fig. 2b). A power commitment therefore depended on both how long it was required and how reliably it had to be delivered.
old.zh: 事件越长，需要延后完成的工作越多，能够持续提供的降功率越小。在参考配置中，完整未来信息（PI）规划下界由一小时的 53.01 kW 降至八小时的 37.76 kW。在所测试的时长范围内，这些下界比恒定的 100.50 kW 名义比较值低 47.3–62.4%（图 1c；补充说明 2）。样本内调度比较也显示了容量随时长下降的趋势（图 2a）。将可靠性目标从 90% 提高到 99%，也降低了为控制器测试选出的容量（图 2b）。因此，一项功率承诺既取决于需要维持多久，也取决于要求以多高的可靠性兑现。

new.en: Limiting eligible work constrained the response. Under perfect information (PI), where the scheduler knows all future arrivals, four-hour planning lower bounds were 2.89, 5.78 and 11.56 kW at 5%, 10% and 20% eligibility. Development-selected offers of 2.95, 5.90 and 11.80 kW then qualified on 300 independent scenarios, corresponding to 1.6–5.9% of the configurations' operating peaks (Fig. 2a; Supplementary Table 4). The 40% and 60% comparisons qualified at 22.19 and 34.00 kW under their additional assumptions. The proportional low-share response follows the shared job-template scaling and allocation policy; it is not an empirically established linear law for production facilities.
new.zh: 限制获准工作量也限制了响应。在完全信息（PI，即调度器事先知道所有未来到达工作）条件下，5%、10%、20% 资格的四小时规划下界为 2.89、5.78、11.56 kW；开发选出的 2.95、5.90、11.80 kW 承诺随后在 300 个独立情景中通过资格检验，相当于各配置运行峰值的 1.6%–5.9%（图 2a；补充表 4）。40% 和 60% 对照在其额外假设下分别合格于 22.19 和 34.00 kW。低比例区间的比例关系来自共同作业模板缩放及分配规则，不是生产设施中经实证确认的线性规律。

old.en: Advance notice provided information but did not necessarily provide room to rearrange work. In the reference case, notice changed planning schedules without increasing their empirical capacity boundaries (Fig. 2c). We then compared 0-, 2- and 6-h notice across 32 service-feasible work/GPU configurations at four- and eight-hour durations, using the same controller and request within each comparison. None of the paired success outcomes changed, although some execution schedules did (Supplementary Table 12). Thus, notice alone did not improve delivery at these requests. The test did not determine whether a different controller or a separately selected offer could benefit from notice.
old.zh: 提前通知提供了信息，但不一定提供重新安排工作的余地。在参考配置中，通知改变了规划调度，却没有提高样本内的容量边界（图 2c）。随后，我们在 32 个满足服务要求的工作/GPU 比例配置中，针对四小时和八小时事件比较了提前 0、2、6 h 通知；每组比较使用同一控制器和同一功率请求。虽然部分执行安排改变了，但配对的成功或失败结果均未改变（补充表 12）。因此，在这些请求下，仅提前通知没有改善履约。该测试没有判断其他控制器或按通知时长重新选择的承诺能否从中获益。

new.en: The same selected power qualified at four and eight hours on this finite grid, but longer events reduced observed success from 295/300 to 292/300 in every configuration. The one-sided 95% probability lower bounds were 0.9662 and 0.9533, respectively. Zero-, two- and six-hour notice produced identical paired success outcomes (Fig. 2b). In this model, jobs cannot execute before release and the no-response reference already processes available work eagerly. Advance information therefore does not establish additional pre-executable work. The fixed-request result does not rule out notice benefits under another baseline schedule, workload release pattern or controller.
new.zh: 在该有限网格内，相同承诺功率同时通过四小时和八小时检验，但较长事件使各配置的观察成功数从 295/300 降为 292/300，单侧 95% 概率下界分别为 0.9662 和 0.9533。提前零、二、六小时通知的配对成功结果完全一致（图 2b）。模型不允许作业在释放前执行，无响应参考也已尽早处理可用工作，因此提前获得信息并不自动增加可提前执行的工作。固定请求的结果不能排除其他基准调度、释放模式或控制器下的通知收益。

old.en: ### Repeated commitments require a specified call schedule and recovery conditions
old.zh: ### 重复承诺需要明确调用安排和恢复条件

new.en: ### Repeated delivery depends on the call programme
new.zh: ### 重复交付取决于具体调用安排

old.en: A capacity qualified for one event did not automatically support repeated calls. At the same 36.71-kW request, four eight-hour calls separated by twelve-hour gaps succeeded in 213/300 new scenarios (71.0%). With earlier-call effects removed by running each call separately at the same clock time, all four calls succeeded in 290/300 scenarios (96.7%). The paired decrease was 25.7 percentage points (95% interval, 21.0–30.3; Supplementary Table 15). This comparison isolates the consequence of call history within the model. Conversely, four-hour calls with eight-hour gaps retained the original 39.65-kW offer: both repeated and isolated-call combinations succeeded in 299/300 scenarios, and the repeated offer passed qualification.
old.zh: 单次事件通过确认的容量，并不自动适用于重复调用。在相同的 36.71 kW 请求下，四次八小时调用、调用之间间隔十二小时的方案，在 300 个新情景中有 213 个成功，即 71.0%。将每次调用放在相同时刻单独运行、移除此前调用的影响后，四次调用全部成功的情景为 290/300，即 96.7%。配对下降为 25.7 个百分点（95% 区间为 21.0–30.3；补充表 15）。这一比较在模型内分离出了调用历史的影响。另一方面，四小时调用、间隔八小时的方案能够保留原来的 39.65 kW 承诺：连续调用和独立调用组合均在 299/300 个情景中成功，连续承诺也通过了资格确认。

new.en: Call history reduced reliability for the longer service. At 10% eligibility and the same 5.90-kW request, four four-hour calls with eight-hour gaps succeeded in all 300 confirmation scenarios, matching four isolated calls at the same clock times. Four eight-hour calls with twelve-hour gaps instead succeeded in 256/300 scenarios, compared with 297/300 for the isolated calls. The paired difference was -13.7 percentage points (95% interval, -17.7 to -9.7). Both conditions required all four calls to pass; Fig. 3 and Supplementary Table 5 report every workload configuration.
new.zh: 调用历史降低了较长服务的可靠性。在 10% 资格、相同 5.90 kW 请求下，四次四小时调用、间隔八小时，在全部 300 个确认情景中成功，与相同时刻分别运行的四次独立调用一致。四次八小时调用、间隔十二小时，则只有 256/300 成功，独立调用为 297/300。配对差异为 -13.7 个百分点（95% 区间 -17.7 至 -9.7）。两种条件都要求四次调用全部通过；五档工作配置均见图 3 和补充表 5。

old.en: Programme-specific selection identified qualified offers for nine of ten tested schedules. Candidates were selected on separate development scenarios and then independently confirmed; their success-probability lower bounds were 0.971–0.991. Four-hour calls with twenty-four-hour gaps qualified at 29.74 kW, and eight-hour calls with two- or four-hour gaps qualified at 33.04 kW. Other selected offers were 9.18–9.91 kW. These are conservative tested options, not estimates of the largest possible offer or the minimum required derating. Figure 3 shows the initial diagnostic at higher planning requests; Supplementary Table 15 provides the subsequent comparison at certified and separately selected requests.
old.zh: 针对各调用方案单独选择容量后，十个测试方案中的九个获得了通过确认的承诺。候选容量在另一组开发情景上选出，再进行独立确认，其成功概率下界为 0.971–0.991。四小时调用、间隔二十四小时的方案通过了 29.74 kW；八小时调用、间隔二小时或四小时的方案通过了 33.04 kW。其他选中承诺为 9.18–9.91 kW。这些是经过检验的保守选项，并非最大可能承诺或最小必要降额的估计。图 3 展示较高规划请求下的初始诊断；补充表 15 给出了随后在已认证请求和另行选出请求下的比较。

new.en: Across all five configurations, the prespecified original offers passed the four-hour repeated confirmation criterion (300/300; probability lower bound 0.9911), whereas eight-hour repeated success ranged from 241/300 to 268/300 and failed the criterion. Separately, the 100-scenario development search over 25%, 50%, 75% and 100% of each offer selected no repeated candidate: even its best observed success, 98/100, gave a lower bound of 0.9414. The successful four-hour confirmation is therefore evidence for the prespecified comparator, not a retrospectively selected candidate under the two-stage rule. Event-and-recovery peak-relief failures persisted at reduced requests; these electrical failures do not by themselves establish lost GPU work. The tests distinguish two schedules and do not imply zero repeated capacity.
new.zh: 五档配置的预设原承诺均通过四小时重复方案的确认标准（300/300，概率下界 0.9911），而八小时重复成功数为 241/300 至 268/300，均未通过。另行在 100 个开发情景中搜索各承诺的 25%、50%、75%、100%，没有选出重复候选：即使最好的观察成功数 98/100，下界也只有 0.9414。因此，四小时确认成功支持的是预设对照，不能事后把它改称为按两阶段规则选出的候选。降低请求后仍出现事件及恢复窗口的峰值削减失败；这些电气失败本身不能证明 GPU 工作损失。检验区分了两种安排，不意味着重复容量为零。

old.en: ### Grid benefits favour additional PV hosting over greater use of existing PV
old.zh: ### 电网收益主要表现为可接入更多光伏，既有光伏利用率提升较小

new.en: ### Workload eligibility changes both PV hosting and local utilisation
new.zh: ### 工作资格改变光伏承载与本地利用

old.en: Flexible computing created more room for PV installation than additional use of PV already installed. We evaluated both outcomes in a community planning model that enforced computing service, network limits and at most 5% PV curtailment. At the reference 201-kW data-centre scale, flexibility increased the PV capacity feasible in all 100 validation scenarios by 32.83 kW without BESS and 33.38 kW with BESS (Fig. 4a,b). These common-capacity gains describe an installation supported across the tested scenarios; the larger mean gains within individual scenarios are reported separately in Supplementary Note 4.
old.zh: 灵活计算带来的收益，更多表现为允许安装更多光伏，而不是进一步增加既有光伏的利用。我们在同时满足计算服务、网络限额和光伏弃电率不超过 5% 的社区规划模型中比较这两种收益。在参考 201 kW 数据中心规模下，灵活性使全部 100 个验证情景均可行的光伏装机容量，在无储能和有储能时分别增加 32.83 kW 和 33.38 kW（图 4a,b）。这些共同容量增量对应的是在所有测试情景中都能支持的装机；按单个情景计算的平均增量更大，单独列于补充说明 4。

new.en: With the 576-GPU installation fixed, flexibility increased all-scenario PV hosting by 2.82, 5.40 and 10.36 kW at 5%, 10% and 20% eligibility without BESS. At 10%, the gain with BESS was 5.22 kW (Fig. 4a; Supplementary Table 6). These capacities were feasible across all 100 paired confirmation scenarios under at most 5% curtailment and zero deadline misses. Each configuration used its own power model and the same 1,100-kW PCC rating, enabling paired comparisons at a fixed GPU installation.
new.zh: 固定 576 张 GPU 时，在无储能条件下，5%、10%、20% 资格的灵活性分别使全情景光伏承载增加 2.82、5.40、10.36 kW。10% 资格配储能时增加 5.22 kW（图 4a；补充表 6）。这些容量在全部 100 个配对确认情景中均满足弃光不超过 5% 且截止时间损失为零。各配置使用自身功率模型及共同的 1,100 kW PCC 限制，在固定 GPU 设施下进行配对比较。

old.en: Keeping PV capacity fixed at 500 kW instead yielded utilisation increases of only 0.0720 percentage points without BESS and 0.0227 with BESS (Fig. 4c). Requiring every job to meet its deadline preserved both these small gains and the approximately 33-kW hosting increases. Flexibility also helped accommodate a larger data centre: at three times the reference scale, flexible operation was feasible in all 100 scenarios, compared with 31 without BESS and 96 with BESS under rigid operation. These are full-information planning benefits; they do not establish the same gains under the tested causal controller or a general reduction in PCC peak demand.
old.zh: 如果保持光伏装机为 500 kW，利用率在无储能时仅提高 0.0720 个百分点，在有储能时仅提高 0.0227 个百分点（图 4c）。要求所有作业均按期完成后，这些较小的利用率增益和约 33 kW 的接入容量增益都得到保留。灵活性也帮助系统容纳更大的数据中心：当规模达到参考值的三倍时，灵活运行在全部 100 个情景中可行；刚性运行在无储能和有储能时分别仅有 31 个和 96 个情景可行。这些是完整未来信息下的规划收益，尚不能证明测试过的因果控制器也能获得相同收益，或 PCC 峰值功率会普遍下降。

new.en: For a fixed 500-kW PV installation, the 10% case increased local utilisation by only 0.0057 percentage points without BESS (95% paired interval, 0.0019–0.0106). With BESS, the reported difference was below 0.0001 percentage points and was not resolved at the configured mixed-integer optimisation precision (Fig. 4b). Small signed storage contrasts are retained in the data; sampling intervals do not include optimisation error. This energy-fraction metric answers a different question from additional installed kilowatts. Storage and flexible work therefore require evaluation within the same local model.
new.zh: 对于固定 500 kW 光伏装置，10% 资格在无储能时使本地利用率仅提高 0.0057 个百分点（95% 配对区间 0.0019–0.0106）。有储能时，报告差异小于 0.0001 个百分点，未达到当前混合整数求解精度下可分辨的水平（图 4b）。源数据保留有储能时的微小正负差异；抽样区间不包含优化误差。这一电量比例指标与新增安装千瓦回答不同问题，储能与灵活工作因此需要在同一本地模型中联合评估。

old.en: The benefits of flexible computing and storage overlapped. In the data-centre hosting comparison, adding BESS reduced the incremental benefit of AI flexibility, with interactions of −52.31 kW without PV and −88.54 kW with PV (Fig. 4d). Flexibility complemented PV in the absence of storage, whereas the smaller interaction with storage did not meet the declared practical-effect criterion. Thus, resource portfolios had to be evaluated together: adding the benefits of computing flexibility, PV and batteries separately would miss their interactions.
old.zh: 灵活计算与储能的收益存在重叠。在数据中心可接入容量的比较中，加入储能降低了 AI 灵活性带来的额外收益；无光伏和有光伏时，交互效应分别为 −52.31 kW 和 −88.54 kW（图 4d）。没有储能时，灵活性与光伏互补；有储能时，较小的交互效应没有达到预先规定的实际意义标准。因此，需要一起评价资源组合：分别计算计算灵活性、光伏和电池的收益再直接相加，会遗漏它们之间的相互作用。

new.en: These renewable results use full future information, zero missed-work allowance and separately optimised schedules. They establish conditional planning benefits, not a demonstration that the causal demand-response controller achieves the same PV outcomes. The larger eligibility comparisons retain their additional participation or business-composition assumptions throughout the renewable analysis.
new.zh: 这些可再生能源结果采用完整未来信息、零未完成工作额度及单独优化的调度。它们给出有条件的规划收益，不能证明因果需求响应控制器达到了相同光伏结果。高资格对照在整个可再生能源分析中仍附带其额外参与或业务构成假设。

old.en: ### Qualified offers depend on the workload conditions in which they were tested
old.zh: ### 通过确认的承诺依赖于测试所对应的工作负载条件

new.en: ### GPU allocation and rigid-load power affect different parts of the assessment
new.zh: ### GPU 分配与刚性功率影响评估的不同部分

old.en: Independent controller tests converted planning potential into locally qualified offers. Here, reliability was the probability of meeting the combined delivery, recovery and computing-service criteria. After fixing the controller and candidates, we tested 500 previously unused episodes per case. Fifteen of eighteen duration–notice combinations met the 95% reliability target: all tested two- to eight-hour durations passed at every notice level, with capacities of 36.71–45.74 kW and one-sided 95% confidence lower bounds of 0.964–0.985 (Fig. 5c). The larger one-hour candidate, 55.16 kW, failed with a lower bound of 0.936. High planning potential therefore did not guarantee qualification of the selected offer.
old.zh: 独立控制器测试将规划潜力转化为在当地模型条件下通过确认的承诺。这里的可靠性，是同时满足交付、恢复和计算服务判据的概率。控制器和候选容量固定后，每个条件使用 500 个此前未使用的情景测试。十八个“时长—通知”组合中有十五个达到 95% 可靠性目标：所有测试的二至八小时时长，在每个通知水平下均通过，容量为 36.71–45.74 kW，单侧 95% 置信下界为 0.964–0.985（图 5c）。更大的一小时候选容量 55.16 kW 未通过，其下界为 0.936。因此，较大的规划潜力并不保证选出的承诺能够通过确认。

new.en: At fixed 10% eligibility, increasing the flexible GPU allocation from 10% to 20% or 30% left the four- and eight-hour PI bounds at 5.78 and 5.57 kW (Fig. 5a). The unchanged 5.90-kW controller offer also retained 295/300 and 292/300 successes. Extra processing headroom did not supply extra eligible arrivals at the call time. This isolates the allocation effect around the low-eligibility configuration and prevents the primary matching rule from being mistaken for a pure eligibility-only experiment.
new.zh: 固定 10% 资格时，将灵活 GPU 分配由 10% 增至 20% 或 30%，四/八小时 PI 下界仍为 5.78 和 5.57 kW（图 5a）。不变的 5.90 kW 控制器承诺也保持 295/300 和 292/300 的成功数。额外处理余量没有增加调用时已释放的合格工作。这一对照在低资格配置附近单独识别分配影响，避免将主体匹配规则误认为纯资格单因素实验。

old.en: Those offers required requalification when operating conditions changed. Shifting job arrivals and community profiles together reduced success to 383–445 of 500 episodes, and none of the unchanged candidates retained 95% certification. This showed loss of support for the original offers, not absence of usable capacity after reselection. Changing only the community profile, while holding jobs and hardware fixed, left the tested capacity bounds and success counts unchanged but altered PV hosting (Supplementary Fig. 5). The same workload-based offer could therefore have different local grid value, while the joint shift required a new reliability assessment.
old.zh: 运行条件改变后，这些承诺需要重新确认。共同改变作业到达过程和社区剖面，使成功数降至 500 个情景中的 383–445 个，所有保持原值的候选均未继续通过 95% 认证。这说明原承诺失去了证据支持，并不意味着重新选取容量后也没有可用响应。若保持作业和硬件不变、仅改变社区剖面，测试中的容量下界和成功数保持不变，光伏接入容量却发生了变化（补充图 5）。因此，同一个基于工作负载的承诺可能具有不同的局部电网价值；而联合条件变化需要重新评价可靠性。

new.en: Reducing the unmeasured rigid-class active-power proxy from 300 to 225 or 150 W per GPU also left these baseline-relative offers and success counts unchanged (Fig. 5b; Supplementary Fig. 4). The proxy instead changed the operating-peak coefficient from 193.44 to 173.53 or 153.63 kW. Constant rigid consumption cancels in the paired reduction, but it remains part of facility demand, PV integration and proportional economic accounting. An unchanged response estimate therefore does not make the rigid-power assumption irrelevant.
new.zh: 将未测刚性类别的活动功率代理由每 GPU 300 W 降至 225 W 或 150 W，也没有改变这些相对基准的承诺及成功数（图 5b；补充图 4），但运行峰值系数从 193.44 kW 降至 173.53 或 153.63 kW。恒定刚性用电在配对削减量中相消，却仍影响设施需求、光伏配合及按比例经济核算。因此，响应估计不变并不意味着刚性功率假设无关。

old.en: Workload and power assumptions also changed how many kilowatts were available. Varying flexible-arrival utilisation shifted the four-hour planning bound by −9.26 to +37.84 kW and the eight-hour bound by −8.71 to +15.73 kW relative to the reference (Fig. 5b). Hardware-power uncertainty changed absolute capacities while preserving their decline with duration (Fig. 5a). These specified-range tests identify influential inputs; they do not establish robustness to all parameters changing jointly.
old.zh: 工作负载与功率假设也改变了可用响应的千瓦数。改变灵活作业到达利用率，使四小时规划下界相对参考值变化 −9.26 至 +37.84 kW，八小时下界变化 −8.71 至 +15.73 kW（图 5b）。硬件功率不确定性改变了容量的绝对值，但保留了容量随时长下降的趋势（图 5a）。这些指定范围内的测试指出了影响较大的输入，并不能证明全部参数同时变化时结论仍稳健。

new.en: Allocation nevertheless changed local grid value: assigning 20% of GPUs to the flexible pool increased the no-BESS PV hosting gain from 5.40 to 24.99 kW at unchanged 10% work eligibility (Supplementary Fig. 4). Cost controls retained each configuration's complete ledger and its own operating peak (Fig. 5c,d; Supplementary Table 8). At the proportional 1-MW accounting scale, a changed peak also changes the number of reference modules represented; these cost contrasts do not measure GPU procurement. The selected controls do not cover simultaneous changes in arrival correlations, deadlines, online-serving dynamics and all prices.
new.zh: 分配仍改变了本地电网价值：工作资格维持 10%，将 20% GPU 分给灵活池，使无储能光伏承载增量由 5.40 增至 24.99 kW（补充图 4）。成本对照保留各配置完整账本及自身运行峰值（图 5c、d；补充表 8）。在按比例换算的 1 MW 会计尺度下，峰值变化也改变所代表的参考模块数量；这些成本差异不测量 GPU 采购。选定对照未覆盖到达相关性、截止时间、在线服务动态与全部价格的同时变化。

old.en: ### Participation costs distinguish technically qualified offers from worthwhile commitments
old.zh: ### 参与成本决定技术上可行的承诺是否值得提供

new.en: ### Low eligibility concentrates fixed participation costs on fewer offered kilowatts
new.zh: ### 低资格使固定参与成本集中于更少承诺千瓦

old.en: Technical qualification left an economic choice: whether the payment justified the resources used to provide response. We priced the independently certified offers under three participation mechanisms: using existing workload slack, reserving computing headroom, or assuming exposure to displaced valuable computing. Each screen compared response with a matched no-response trajectory through completion of the accounting horizon, including recovery. The reported threshold was the annual capacity payment per offered kilowatt needed to break even under the specified prices and performance compensation (Fig. 6).
old.zh: 通过技术确认之后，仍有一个经济选择：获得的补偿是否足以支持提供响应所需的资源。我们对独立认证的承诺采用三种参与机制核算成本：利用已有工作时间余量、预留计算能力，或假定承担挤占高价值计算的成本暴露。每项筛查均将响应轨迹与匹配的无响应轨迹比较，并核算到包含恢复过程的完整记账时域结束。报告的门槛是在所设定价格和履约补偿下，每千瓦承诺容量每年需要获得多少容量付款才能收支平衡（图 6）。

new.en: We next priced each independently qualified single-event offer using its own response and no-response trajectories through recovery. Annual compensation was the payment per offered kilowatt required to make the fifth percentile of net value non-negative under specified energy, waiting and participation costs. Natural slack, reserved headroom and assumed displaced-value exposure describe different costs of providing the same electrical offer (Fig. 6). They are scenarios for screening participation, not measured operator profits.
new.zh: 随后用各自贯穿恢复期的响应与无响应轨迹，为每个独立合格的单次承诺核算价格。年度补偿为在指定能耗、等待和参与成本下，使净值第 5 百分位不为负所需的每承诺千瓦费用。自然空闲、预留容量与假定挤占价值暴露，描述同一电气承诺的不同供给成本（图 6）。它们用于参与筛选，不是实测运营商利润。

old.en: The same four-hour offer had different participation costs. At a proportional 1-MW accounting scale and 50 independent fresh calls per year, risk-adjusted thresholds were US$246.60 per kW-year using existing slack, US$362.75 with reserved headroom and US$414.99 under assumed displaced-compute exposure (Fig. 6a). All modes incurred the same mean delay-cost contribution of US$123.62 per kW-year; the latter two added reserve-capital or assumed displaced-value charges (Fig. 6c). Existing slack was therefore the least costly of these mechanisms under the reference assumptions. The 1-MW conversion scaled the reference ledger, not the technical certificate.
old.zh: 同一个四小时承诺对应不同的参与成本。在按比例折算为 1 MW 的会计尺度、每年 50 次独立新事件的条件下，利用已有余量的风险调整门槛为每 kW 每年 246.60 美元，预留计算能力为 362.75 美元，假定计算挤占暴露为 414.99 美元（图 6a）。三种机制的平均延迟成本贡献均为每 kW 每年 123.62 美元；后两种额外计入预留资本或假定被挤占价值的费用（图 6c）。因此，在参考假设下，利用已有余量是这三种机制中成本最低的。1 MW 换算放大的是参考账本，并没有把技术证书扩展到更大设施。

new.en: At a proportional 1-MW accounting scale, 50 independent four-hour calls per year and a US$25,000 annual site charge, slack-participation thresholds were US$1653.07, 863.26 and 468.04 per offered kW-year at 5%, 10% and 20% eligibility. For 10%, reserved headroom raised the threshold to US$979.40, and assumed displaced value raised it to US$1003.51 (Fig. 6a; Supplementary Table 7). The 1-MW conversion scales the paired ledger and offered power; it does not certify a 1-MW installation.
new.zh: 在按比例换算的 1 MW 会计尺度、每年 50 个独立四小时调用及 25,000 美元站点年费下，5%、10%、20% 资格的自然空闲参与门槛分别为每承诺 kW 每年 1653.07、863.26、468.04 美元。10% 资格下，预留容量使门槛升至 979.40 美元，假定挤占价值使其升至 1003.51 美元（图 6a；补充表 7）。1 MW 换算按比例缩放配对账本与承诺功率，不认证 1 MW 设施。

old.en: Longer events combined lower capacity with higher required compensation. Extending a slack-backed event from two to eight hours raised the threshold from US$164.67 to US$437.21 per kW-year (Fig. 6d). Small offers also carried a larger fixed-cost burden per kilowatt: with a US$25,000 annual site charge, increasing the accounting scale from 0.2 to 20 MW reduced the four-hour threshold from US$753.53 to US$126.20 per kW-year. Excluding that charge left it at US$119.87 throughout. The scale effect therefore reflected allocation of fixed costs, rather than a demonstrated improvement in hardware efficiency.
old.zh: 更长的事件同时对应较小容量和较高补偿需求。对于利用余量的机制，将事件从二小时延长到八小时，门槛由每 kW 每年 164.67 美元升至 437.21 美元（图 6d）。较小承诺还要承担更高的每千瓦固定成本：在每站点每年 25,000 美元费用下，将会计尺度从 0.2 MW 增至 20 MW，使四小时门槛由每 kW 每年 753.53 美元降至 126.20 美元。剔除该费用后，门槛始终为 119.87 美元。因此，这种规模效应来自固定成本分摊，并非已经证明硬件效率改善。

new.en: The low-share cases deliver less total power while sharing the same site charge. This fixed-cost denominator explains why a smaller eligible pool can require a higher payment per offered kilowatt even though less work is postponed. At 10%, extending calls from four to eight hours changed the slack threshold from US$863.26 to US$949.73 per kW-year at the same selected power (Fig. 6b). Duration therefore changes the cost of the service even when the finite candidate grid selects the same capacity.
new.zh: 低比例情景提供的总功率较少，却承担相同站点费用。这一固定成本分母解释了为何合格池较小时，即使推迟工作较少，每承诺千瓦仍可能需要更高补偿。10% 资格下，承诺功率不变，将调用从四小时延长到八小时，使自然空闲门槛从每 kW 每年 863.26 变为 949.73 美元（图 6b）。因此，即使有限网格选出相同容量，时长仍会改变服务成本。

old.en: The price of delay materially affected this choice. At four hours, holding site cost and call exposure fixed, varying delay price from zero to twice the reference moved the slack-backed threshold from US$117.04 to US$376.19 per kW-year. Monetary and numerical-sampling sensitivities are reported in Supplementary Tables 7–9. The resulting thresholds support comparison under declared cost assumptions, rather than a forecast of operator profit.
old.zh: 延迟价格会实质性地改变这一选择。在四小时事件下，保持站点成本和调用暴露不变，将延迟价格从零变为参考值的两倍，使利用余量的门槛从每 kW 每年 117.04 美元变为 376.19 美元。价格和数值抽样敏感性见补充表 7–9。所得门槛支持在明确成本假设下比较方案，而不是预测运营商实际利润。

new.en: At 10% eligibility, changing the waiting price from zero to twice its reference value moved the four-hour slack threshold from US$810.73 to US$915.95 per kW-year. Fixed site charges, assumed displaced values, missed-work prices and reserve life were also varied (Supplementary Fig. 5; Supplementary Table 9). The reserve-life calculation is an accounting sensitivity, not a measurement of GPU ageing or a substitute for procurement data.
new.zh: 10% 资格下，将等待价格从零调至参考值的两倍，四小时自然空闲门槛由每 kW 每年 810.73 美元变为 915.95 美元。另改变站点固定费、假定挤占价值、未完成工作价格与预留寿命（补充图 5；补充表 9）。预留寿命计算属于会计敏感性，不是 GPU 老化测量，也不能替代采购数据。

old.en: Repeated programmes linked compensation to the chosen capacity and call schedule. For the nine confirmed selected offers, twelve independent four-call series per year required US$677–1,768 per offered kW-year at the same 1-MW accounting scale. For example, in the reference model, eight-hour calls with four-hour gaps qualified at 33.04 kW and required about US$731 per kW-year, whereas twelve-hour gaps had a selected 9.18-kW offer and required about US$1,768 (Supplementary Table 19). Each complete series was accounted once per hour, including failed episodes. These are costs of the tested options, not an optimised capacity–cost frontier; they retain history within each series but assume independence between annualised series. Missed-work price sensitivity for the affected four-hour/twenty-four-hour-gap programme is reported separately.
old.zh: 连续方案把补偿需求与所选容量和调用安排联系起来。对于九个通过确认的选中承诺，在相同的 1 MW 会计尺度下，每年十二个相互独立的四调用序列需要每千瓦承诺容量每年 677–1,768 美元。例如，在参考模型中，八小时调用、间隔四小时的方案通过了 33.04 kW，对应门槛约为每 kW 每年 731 美元；间隔十二小时的方案选出 9.18 kW，对应门槛约为 1,768 美元（补充表 19）。每个完整序列逐小时只记一次账，失败情景也保留在内。这些是已测试选项的成本，并非经过优化的容量—成本前沿；序列内部保留历史，年化时仍假定不同序列相互独立。存在未按期完成工作的四小时/二十四小时间隔方案，另行报告了损失价格敏感性。

new.en: Repeated-programme ledgers retained every hour once across all four calls and the clearance tail, including failed trajectories. Their conditional prices are shown for all five configurations at twelve independent series per year (Fig. 6c). Filled markers identify original offers passing the four-hour confirmation criterion; crosses identify the eight-hour failures. Neither price changes the separate finding that the development rule selected no repeated candidate. Non-performance penalties are unpriced, and independent series do not represent a continuously operating year.
new.zh: 重复方案账本将四次调用及清空尾段中的每小时仅计一次，并保留失败轨迹。五档均给出每年十二个独立序列下的条件价格（图 6c）。实心标记表示通过四小时确认标准的原承诺，叉号表示八小时未通过。两种价格都不改变开发规则没有选出重复候选这一独立结果。不履约罚金未定价，独立序列也不代表连续全年运行。

old.en: These results connect three decisions that are often assessed separately: which computing work may wait, what response programme can preserve service, and what payment makes that programme worth offering. Increasing eligibility expanded planning capacity, but increasing flexible GPU allocation could also change the baseline load available to curtail. Independent testing then determined which selected offers met the stated service conditions. This extends the decision context of data-centre response demonstrations<sup>2</sup> and workload-aware scheduling studies,<sup>4–17</sup> by attaching delivery evidence and participation costs to specified commitments.
old.zh: 这些结果联系了三个通常分开评价的决定：哪些计算工作可以等待，什么响应方案能够保持服务，以及多少付款使该方案值得提供。提高可延后工作比例扩大了规划容量，但增加灵活 GPU 分配也可能改变可削减的基准负荷。随后，独立测试确定哪些选中承诺满足所规定的服务条件。这在数据中心响应示范<sup>2</sup>和考虑工作负载的调度研究<sup>4–17</sup>基础上，将履约证据和参与成本对应到具体承诺，扩展了决策评价的内容。

new.en: The main implication is that a workload assumption must travel with its downstream conclusions. Explicitly limiting permission to 5–20% of offered work produced single-event offers of only 2.95–11.80 kW in this model. Larger values required broader batch participation or a changed business mix. This connects production workload characterisation<sup>29</sup> to the commitment question raised by field demonstrations<sup>2</sup> and scheduling studies,<sup>4–17</sup> without treating a candidate low-priority pool as an observed demand-response resource.
new.zh: 主要启示是，工作负载假设必须与下游结论始终对应。将获准份额明确限制在总投入工作的 5%–20%，本模型的单次承诺仅为 2.95–11.80 kW。更大数值需要扩大批处理参与或改变业务构成。这将生产工作负载刻画<sup>29</sup>与现场示范<sup>2</sup>及调度研究<sup>4–17</sup>提出的承诺问题连接起来，同时避免将低优先级候选池当作已观察到的需求响应资源。

old.en: Dispatch history made the call schedule part of the resource definition. One programme sustained its original single-event offer, while others required separately qualified candidates. Recovery conditions also mattered: in the fixed controller, the allowed recovery power depends on no-response consumption. Stopping arrivals lowered that baseline and restricted catch-up execution, explaining why the horizon intervention changed service after identical event trajectories. Thus, the relevant constraint was not accumulated work alone, but the ability to complete it under the operating rules. The unsuccessful queue-based prediction test leaves a general capacity rule unresolved; it does not remove the programme-specific evidence.
old.zh: 调用历史使调用安排成为资源定义的一部分。一个方案可以维持原单次承诺，其他方案则需要单独确认候选容量。恢复条件也很重要：固定控制器所允许的恢复功率取决于无响应功耗。停止新增作业会降低这一基准，限制补回工作的执行，从而解释了为什么相同的事件期轨迹会在改变时域后产生不同的服务结果。因此，相关约束不仅是积累了多少工作，还包括能否按照运行规则把这些工作完成。队列预测测试未成功，说明通用容量规则仍未建立；各具体方案的检验证据则仍然成立。

new.en: Repeated operation exposed the limits of transferring a single-event certificate. The four-hour programme passed independent confirmation at the original offer, whereas the eight-hour programme did not. The development grid nevertheless selected no repeated candidate, demonstrating that the prespecified selection outcome and a successful independent comparator test must be reported separately. Peak relief over event-and-recovery windows remained a limiting electrical condition even at reduced requests. These failures do not justify attributing every unsuccessful programme to lost computing work or inferring a universal derating factor. A different controller, finer capacity search or revised schedule would require a new independent test.
new.zh: 重复运行暴露了单次证书迁移的限制。四小时方案在原承诺下通过独立确认，八小时方案则未通过；开发网格仍未选出重复候选，说明必须分别报告预设选值规则的结果与独立对照检验成功。即使请求降低，事件及恢复窗口峰值削减仍是限制性的电气条件。这些失败不能支持把所有未成功方案归因于计算工作损失，也不能据此推断通用降额系数。不同控制器、更细容量搜索或改变安排，都需要新的独立检验。

old.en: The local grid objective determined what flexibility was worth. Our model found a larger benefit for accommodating additional PV than for increasing use of an existing installation. Storage reduced some incremental gains because the resources relieved overlapping constraints. A battery's power, energy and state of charge differ from the job deadlines and future processing needs that constrain deferred computing.<sup>23</sup> Their combined value therefore requires joint evaluation.<sup>20–24</sup> The paired community-profile comparison also showed that an unchanged workload-based offer can have different hosting value in different local demand profiles.
old.zh: 局部电网希望实现什么目标，决定了灵活性的价值。模型中，允许接入更多光伏的收益大于提高既有装机利用率的收益。储能降低了部分额外增益，因为这些资源缓解的约束存在重叠。电池受功率、能量和荷电状态限制，而推迟计算受作业截止时间及未来处理需求限制。<sup>23</sup> 因此，两者的组合价值需要共同评价。<sup>20–24</sup> 社区剖面的配对比较还表明，即便基于工作负载的承诺不变，在不同局部负荷剖面中也可能具有不同的接入容量价值。

new.en: Workload permission also changed the local planning and accounting context. Hosting additional PV and increasing the use of an installed system require different calculations, and battery storage changes both opportunities. Their values cannot be added independently.<sup>20–24</sup> Likewise, a constant rigid-power term can cancel in baseline-relative response while still affecting the facility peak, grid integration and economic scaling.
new.zh: 工作授权也改变本地规划和会计背景。新增光伏承载与提高已安装系统的利用需要不同计算，电池储能会改变两种机会，不能将它们的价值独立相加。<sup>20–24</sup> 同样，恒定刚性功率项可在相对基准的响应中相消，却仍影响设施峰值、电网配合及经济缩放。

old.en: The economic comparison distinguished payment for an available resource from the cost of creating that resource. Existing slack had the lowest threshold among the three tested mechanisms, while reserve capital and assumed displaced value added costs. For repeated programmes, the selected offer also set the denominator over which fixed site costs were spread. The complete-series ledger retained waiting and service losses, including the nonzero missed work in one qualified programme. These thresholds can be recalculated for other prices and payment rules; proportional scaling and independent-series annualisation do not establish continuous-year profitability.
old.zh: 经济比较区分了利用已有资源所需的付款与额外创造这项资源的成本。在测试的三种机制中，已有余量的门槛最低；预留资本和假定被挤占的价值则增加费用。对于连续方案，所选承诺还决定了固定站点费用分摊到多少千瓦容量上。完整序列账本保留等待和服务损失，包括一个通过确认方案中非零的未按期完成工作。这些门槛可按其他价格和付款规则重新计算；按比例放大和独立序列年化并不能证明全年连续运行盈利。

new.en: Lower eligibility concentrates fixed site costs on a smaller offer. Reserved headroom and hypothetical displaced value can add further charges, while longer calls increase waiting exposure. The complete ledgers make these mechanisms recalculable at other prices. They do not establish actual GPU wear, operator revenue loss or profitability, and a low conditional price cannot compensate for an unqualified repeated programme. Technical qualification remains a prerequisite for interpreting a participation threshold as an offerable option.
new.zh: 较低资格使固定站点成本集中于更小承诺。预留容量和假定挤占价值可增加收费，较长调用则增加等待暴露。完整账本使这些机制可在其他价格下重新计算，但不能证明真实 GPU 磨损、运营商收入损失或盈利；较低条件价格也不能弥补重复方案不合格。将参与门槛解释为可报价选项之前，技术资格仍是前提。

old.en: For an operator, the assessment begins with the jobs permitted to wait and the computing resources available to finish them. The next choice is a duration, capacity and call schedule that passes independent controller testing; changed workload conditions require that evidence to be revisited. Grid benefits and participation costs can then be evaluated for the relevant operating conditions, keeping full-information planning benefits distinct from qualified controller performance. This sequence is consistent with capacity assessment for other resources whose actions are coupled over time.<sup>25,26</sup> It provides tested options and their conditions, without presuming that the largest planning estimate is the best commitment.
old.zh: 对于运营商，评价首先要明确哪些工作可以等待，以及有哪些计算资源用于将它们完成。下一步是选择通过独立控制器测试的时长、容量和调用安排；工作负载条件改变后，应重新检查证据。随后，可以在相应运行条件下评价电网收益和参与成本，同时区分完整未来信息的规划收益与通过确认的控制器表现。这与其他具有跨时段耦合行为的资源容量评价思路一致。<sup>25,26</sup> 它提供的是经过测试的选项及适用条件，不预设最大的规划估计就是最合适的承诺。

new.en: For an operator, the assessment begins with an inventory of work that is contractually permitted to wait, together with the hardware and deadlines available to complete it. A capacity and call schedule can then be selected and independently tested before local grid benefits and participation costs are assessed. This is consistent with capacity assessment for other resources whose actions are coupled over time.<sup>25,26</sup> Changing the workload mix requires the downstream calculations to be repeated; a sensitivity curve for planning potential alone cannot establish the reliability or economics of a different operating configuration.
new.zh: 对运营商而言，评估应先盘点合同允许等待的工作，以及完成它所需的硬件和截止时间。随后选择容量与调用安排，进行独立检验，再评估本地电网收益和参与成本。这与其他跨时段相互制约资源的容量评估相一致。<sup>25,26</sup> 工作构成改变之后，必须重做下游计算；单有规划潜力的敏感性曲线，不能证明另一种运行配置的可靠性或经济性。

old.en: The numerical offers remain specific to the modelled workloads and operating rules. Jobs were divisible and pre-emptible at hourly resolution, with synthetic deadlines and separate rigid and flexible GPU pools. Production arrival counts tested temporal variation, while job sizes and service rules remained modelled; the eight observed weeks were not independent deployments. Community demand came from building-stock simulations, and four-GPU measurements anchored board power. Actual task-recovery overhead, facility-scale response, GPU ageing, operator procurement costs and continuous annual economics remain outside the evidence. These limitations define where additional deployment-specific measurements would be needed, while the present results support comparisons within the declared model conditions.
old.zh: 具体承诺数值仍适用于模型中的工作负载和运行规则。作业在小时尺度上可分割、可抢占，截止时间为合成设置，刚性与灵活 GPU 池彼此分开。生产作业到达数量用于检验时间变化，但作业尺寸和服务规则仍由模型设定；八个观测周不是独立部署。社区需求来自建筑群模拟，四卡实测则为板卡功率提供依据。真实任务恢复开销、设施尺度响应、GPU 老化、运营商采购费用和全年连续经济性仍不在现有证据之内。这些限制界定了在部署时需要哪些进一步测量；当前结果支持的是明确模型条件下的比较。

new.en: These numerical results remain conditional model evidence. Requested GPU-hours from one production infrastructure are not energy measurements or an industry workload census. Deferral permission and deadlines were assumed; hourly divisible jobs, constant rigid demand and a small board-power calibration do not reproduce online latency, checkpoint overhead or facility response. The 40% and 60% cases add unverified participation and business-composition assumptions. The repeated tests cover two four-call schedules followed by a clearance tail, and annual costs sample independent episodes rather than a continuous year. Actual GPU procurement, ageing and contractual failure penalties require operator data. These limitations constrain numerical transfer while leaving the five-scenario comparisons reproducible.
new.zh: 这些数值仍是有条件的模型证据。单个生产基础设施的申请 GPU 小时不是能耗测量或行业工作负载普查。延后授权和截止时间为假设；小时级可分割作业、恒定刚性需求及小规模板卡校准，不能复现在线延迟、检查点开销或设施响应。40% 和 60% 情景增加了未经验证的参与和业务构成假设。重复测试覆盖两种四调用安排及之后的清空尾段，年度成本抽样独立情景，未模拟连续全年。真实 GPU 采购、老化及合同违约罚金需要运营商数据。这些限制约束了数值外推，同时保留五档比较的可复现性。

old.en: We evaluated four levels of capacity evidence: an assumed nominal flexible fraction; a perfect-information (PI) schedule with access to the full future episode; a restricted non-anticipative (NA) schedule with decisions shared across indistinguishable histories; and a fixed causal controller tested on independent episodes. Here, causal means that the controller uses only information available at the decision time. Nominal flexibility was calculated from the reference-mix operating peak. PI and NA supplied planning comparisons; independent controller testing supplied the operational certificate.
old.zh: 我们评估了四个层次的容量证据：假定的名义可调比例；可以获取整个未来回合信息的完全信息（PI）调度；在无法区分的历史之间共享决策的受限非前瞻（NA）调度；以及在独立回合上测试的固定因果控制器。这里，“因果”指控制器仅使用决策当时可获得的信息。名义灵活性根据参考混合工作负载的运行峰值计算。PI 与 NA 用于规划比较，独立控制器测试则提供运行容量证书。

new.en: The primary comparison followed five declared workload-eligibility scenarios through perfect-information (PI) planning, independent causal-controller testing, repeated programmes, PV integration and participation costs. Eligibility was the share of offered GPU-hours permitted to wait. Capacity was evaluated against the same delivery and service criteria within each declared call programme.
new.zh: 主体比较围绕五档声明的工作资格情景，依次评估完全信息（PI）规划、独立因果控制器检验、重复方案、光伏配合及参与成本。资格指投入 GPU 小时中获准等待的份额。每个声明的调用方案均按相同交付与服务标准评估容量。

old.en: We tested reliability targets of 0.90, 0.95 and 0.99, with 0.95 as the headline. Capacity is conditional on the policy and episode distribution. A single-event certificate averages over its declared fresh-event states. The extension tested complete four-call programmes and selected candidate offers on separate development data; it did not estimate the maximum capacity for every possible queue state.
old.zh: 我们检验了 0.90、0.95 和 0.99 三个可靠性目标，以 0.95 为主要目标。容量取决于控制策略和情景分布。单次事件证书对应其预先规定的新事件状态分布。新增研究检验完整的四次调用方案，并在单独的开发数据上选择候选承诺；它没有估计每一种可能队列状态下的最大容量。

new.en: The primary reliability target was 0.95. Capacity was conditional on the controller, workload scenario and call schedule. We selected the largest qualifying candidate on a finite development grid and tested that candidate independently; this procedure does not estimate the continuous maximum of the capacity function. Pointwise probability lower bounds were used for individual offers, without a simultaneous guarantee over all configurations.
new.zh: 主体可靠性目标为 0.95。容量取决于控制器、工作负载情景和调用安排。我们在有限开发网格中选择通过门槛的最大候选，再独立检验该候选；这一过程不估计容量函数的连续最大值。各项承诺采用逐项概率下界，并未给出覆盖所有配置的联合保证。

old.en: Model A and the analysis plan were frozen after the predeclared notice diagnostic and before validation or locked testing. Non-overlapping seed ranges defined 100 development episodes (10,000–10,099), 100 validation episodes (20,000–20,099), 500 locked in-distribution episodes (30,000–30,499) and 500 locked out-of-distribution episodes (40,000–40,499). Development established mechanisms and technical sensitivities; validation replicated planning results and selected controller capacities. Each locked set was used once, without capacity reselection. Configurations, scenarios and source artifacts were hashed before evaluation.
old.zh: 在预先声明的提前通知诊断完成后、验证和锁定测试开始前，Model A 与分析计划被冻结。互不重叠的随机种子范围分别定义了 100 个开发回合（10,000–10,099）、100 个验证回合（20,000–20,099）、500 个锁定同分布回合（30,000–30,499）和 500 个锁定分布外回合（40,000–40,499）。开发集用于确立机制和技术敏感性；验证集用于复现规划结果并选择控制器容量。每个锁定集合仅使用一次，期间不重新选择容量。评估前对配置、情景和源文件计算哈希值。

new.en: This extension was specified after the earlier benchmark. One hundred development seeds (930000–930099) selected offers, and 300 previously unexamined confirmation seeds (960000–960299) tested them without reselection. The delivered-power recovery guard and feasible-side action rounding were corrected on development data before this controller version was confirmed. Protocol, source, controller and scenario hashes identify the evidence; original locked certificates remain separate historical results.
new.zh: 本扩展在此前基准之后制定。100 个开发种子（930000–930099）用于选承诺，300 个此前未查看的确认种子（960000–960299）在不重新选值的条件下检验。实际交付功率的恢复保护及可行侧动作舍入在开发数据上修正后，再对该控制器版本进行确认。协议、来源、控制器和情景哈希标识对应证据；原锁定证书作为独立历史结果保存。

old.en: Community demand used the End-Use Load Profiles for the US Building Stock,<sup>27,28</sup> combining 75% ResStock detached-residence and 25% ComStock small-office demand in ASHRAE climate zones 3A, 3C and 5A. These are building-stock simulations calibrated against measurements, not project-owned feeder records. Fifteen-minute interval-ending power was averaged to hourly intervals, and each mixed profile was scaled while retaining its temporal shape. Model A used mixed 3A demand with an 800-kW background peak and a 1,000-kW PCC import limit. The joint distribution shift used mixed 3C demand and a changed workload-arrival process under the frozen evaluation protocol.
old.zh: 社区需求采用美国建筑存量终端用能曲线，<sup>27,28</sup> 在 ASHRAE 气候区 3A、3C 和 5A 中，混合 75% 的 ResStock 独立住宅需求与 25% 的 ComStock 小型办公楼需求。这些数据是以测量数据校准的建筑存量模拟结果，并非本项目自行采集的馈线记录。将以区间结束时刻标记的 15 min 功率平均为小时值，再在保留时间形状的前提下缩放混合曲线。Model A 采用混合 3A 曲线，背景峰值为 800 kW，公共连接点进口功率上限为 1,000 kW。联合分布变化在冻结评估协议下，同时采用混合 3C 需求和改变后的工作负载到达过程。

new.en: Community demand used the End-Use Load Profiles for the US Building Stock,<sup>27,28</sup> combining 75% detached-residence and 25% small-office demand in the mixed 3A profile. These are building-stock simulations calibrated against measurements. Fifteen-minute power was averaged to hourly intervals and scaled to an 800-kW background peak. All five configurations used a common 1,100-kW PCC import rating and prohibited exports. This rating accommodates the unchanged 576-GPU installation across the changing workload mixes; three initial development baselines exceeded the earlier 1,000-kW rating, so the common site rating was amended before formal PI optimisation or controller selection. Those baseline records were retained.
new.zh: 社区需求采用美国建筑存量的终端用电曲线，<sup>27,28</sup> 在混合 3A 曲线中将 75% 独栋住宅需求与 25% 小型办公需求组合。这些曲线是经测量校准的建筑存量模拟。15 分钟功率平均为小时值，再缩放至 800 kW 背景峰值。五档配置均采用相同的 1,100 kW 公共连接点（PCC）进口容量，并禁止反向送电。该容量适应工作构成变化下保持不变的 576 张 GPU：初始开发基准中有三项超过此前的 1,000 kW 额定值，因此在正式 PI 优化和控制器选值前统一调整站点容量，并保留了这些基准记录。

old.en: Synthetic AI arrivals were informed by the 2026 Alibaba Serverless Infrastructure trace, covering six months and 155,410 heterogeneous GPUs,<sup>29</sup> which extends the earlier public 6,742-GPU trace.<sup>30</sup> From the official 40,522,321-row job-execution summary, we formed a reproducible 100,000-row sampler containing equal numbers of low-priority training and offline-inference records. This project-made sampler supplied job-size, runtime and GPU-demand distributions; source timestamps were not replayed. An independent-reservoir comparison supported central and 95th-percentile summaries but failed one tail-sensitive distribution diagnostic (Supplementary Information). Production deadlines were unavailable in the summary, so deadlines were generated from a declared class-specific slack policy. The model did not reproduce pod-hourly temporal correlations.
old.zh: 人工生成的 AI 作业到达过程参考了 2026 年阿里巴巴 Serverless 基础设施运行记录；该记录覆盖六个月和 155,410 块异构 GPU，<sup>29</sup> 延续了此前公开的 6,742 GPU 运行记录。<sup>30</sup> 我们从官方 40,522,321 行作业执行汇总表中，构建了可复现的 100,000 行采样表，其中低优先级训练与离线推理记录各占一半。该项目自建采样表提供作业大小、运行时间和 GPU 需求分布，并未回放源时间戳。与独立蓄水池采样结果的比较支持中心位置和第 95 百分位的汇总特征，但未通过一项对尾部敏感的分布诊断（见补充信息）。汇总表不提供生产截止时间，因此根据预先声明的类别特定宽裕时间规则生成截止时间。模型未复现 pod 小时级时间相关性。

new.en: Job shapes came from the Alibaba Serverless Infrastructure execution summary,<sup>29</sup> complementing an earlier public GPU trace.<sup>30</sup> We audited all 40,522,321 released execution spans using requested GPU-equivalents multiplied by uncapped duration. This resource-time denominator retained every workload category; it measures neither energy nor permission to defer work. A reproducible, class-balanced 100,000-record subset supplied low-priority training and offline-inference job shapes. Its balanced record counts were not used to estimate the facility workload mix. Original temporal correlations and production deadlines were unavailable in this summary.
new.zh: 作业形状来自 Alibaba Serverless Infrastructure 执行摘要，<sup>29</sup> 并与较早公开的 GPU 轨迹相衔接。<sup>30</sup> 我们用申请的 GPU 等效数量乘以未截尾的持续时间，审核全部 40,522,321 条公开执行区段。该资源时间分母保留所有工作类别，既不代表能量，也不代表允许延后的资格。一个可复现、类别均衡的 100,000 条记录子集提供低优先级训练和离线推理的作业形状；均衡记录数量不用于估计设施工作构成。该摘要不能提供原始时间相关性或生产截止时间。

old.en: The reference facility contained 144 four-GPU nodes at total arrival utilisation 0.65. Training and offline inference each supplied half of offered GPU-hours; all training and half of offline-inference work could be deferred. Training deadline slack used multipliers of 2–6 within 6–48 h, and offline inference used 1.5–4 within 2–24 h. Episodes comprised seven dispatch days plus a 48-h clearance tail. Single events began at a declared 15:00–20:00 local-clock candidate on days 3–6, with durations of 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 or 8 h and notice of 0, 2 or 6 h. These were experimental event scenarios rather than utility dispatch records.
old.zh: 参考设施包含 144 个四 GPU 节点，作业到达对应的总利用率为 0.65。训练与离线推理各占所提交 GPU-h 的一半；全部训练工作和一半离线推理工作可以推迟。训练截止时间宽裕度采用 2–6 倍的系数，并限制在 6–48 h；离线推理采用 1.5–4 倍，并限制在 2–24 h。回合包含七天调度及其后 48 h 的清空尾段。单次事件在第 3–6 天当地时间 15:00–20:00 的预设候选时刻之一开始，持续时间为 1、2、3、4、6 或 8 h，提前通知为 0、2 或 6 h。这些是实验事件情景，而非电力公司的实际调用记录。

new.en: Each configuration contained 144 four-GPU nodes and offered 374.4 GPU-h per hour. Let s_c denote a class share and a_c its eligible fraction; total eligibility was \(f = \sum_c s_c a_c\). At f = 0.05, 0.10 and 0.20, a common permission multiplier was applied to the observed low-priority training and offline-inference resource-time shares, which together comprised 0.22028 of the source total. At f = 0.40, additional non-low-priority batch work was assumed to opt in. At f = 0.60, the source mix was explicitly changed by replacing 0.19058 of total work from online to offline inference. Online inference remained ineligible in every case. Flexible GPUs were round(576f), giving approximately 65% mean utilisation in both pools; rigid utilisation used the actual integer remainder.
new.zh: 每种配置均含 144 个四 GPU 节点，每小时投入 374.4 GPU 小时的工作量。令 s_c 为类别占比，a_c 为该类别获准延后的比例，总资格为 \(f = \sum_c s_c a_c\)。当 f = 0.05、0.10、0.20 时，对原数据中的低优先级训练和离线推理资源时间占比应用同一个获准系数；这两类合计占原始总量的 0.22028。当 f = 0.40 时，假定更多非低优先级批处理也同意参与。当 f = 0.60 时，显式改变原业务构成，将占总工作量 0.19058 的在线推理替换为离线推理。所有情景中的在线推理都没有延后资格。灵活 GPU 数为 round(576f)，使两池平均利用率均约为 65%；刚性利用率按整数 GPU 的实际剩余数量计算。

old.en: The reference model assumed PUE 1.2 and fixed node overhead of 300 W. This overhead was not measured by the board-power experiment. Lower and upper calibration cases propagated run-level power intervals; additional cases varied PUE and node overhead without resizing the 144-node facility. The operating peak used the reference 50:50 workload mix, rather than a nameplate or worst-class peak. The model therefore scaled measured per-GPU power while treating facility infrastructure separately as an engineering assumption.
old.zh: 参考模型假定 PUE 为 1.2，每节点固定开销为 300 W。该开销并非由板卡功率实验测得。较低与较高校准情形传播了运行层面的功率区间；其他情形改变 PUE 和节点开销，同时保持 144 节点设施规模不变。运行峰值采用参考的 50:50 工作负载组合，而非铭牌峰值或功率最高类别的峰值。因此，模型按实测单 GPU 功率进行扩展，同时将设施基础开销单独作为工程假设。

new.en: The model assumed PUE 1.2 and 300 W of fixed overhead per node. Training and offline-inference active board power used the measured coefficients of 259.08 and 300.02 W per GPU. Online, development, other and unknown rigid workloads used 300.02 W per active GPU as an engineering proxy, with separate 150- and 225-W controls. These coefficients are not measurements of online serving. Rigid demand was held fixed at its class-weighted mean, so online request latency and burst-level power were not simulated. The hardware measurements constrain the batch-work power conversion, not the representativeness of the workload mix.
new.zh: 模型假设 PUE 为 1.2，每个节点固定开销为 300 W。训练与离线推理的活动板卡功率分别采用测得的每 GPU 259.08 W 和 300.02 W 系数。在线、开发、其他和未知刚性工作采用每个活动 GPU 300.02 W 的工程代理，并另设 150 W 和 225 W 对照。这些系数不是在线服务的实测功率。刚性需求固定为类别加权均值，因此没有模拟在线请求延迟或突发阶段功率。硬件测量约束的是批处理的功率换算，而非工作构成的代表性。
