old.en: The PI programme maximised R separately for each scenario. We summarised these maxima using an exact-binomial nonparametric tolerance lower bound at reliability q and confidence 0.95.<sup>31</sup> This selects the largest admissible order statistic supporting the statement that at least a q fraction of the scenario population can attain that reduction. Insufficient sample sizes were labelled not estimable, not assigned zero. The restricted NA programme coupled decisions with the same available information and reported a finite-ensemble empirical bound. Its descriptive PI comparison used the same allowed failure count, without replacing the population tolerance calculation.
old.zh: PI 优化分别在每个情景中最大化 R。我们使用可靠性 q、置信度 0.95 的精确二项式非参数容忍下界，汇总这些最大值。<sup>31</sup> 该方法选择符合统计条件的最大次序统计量，以支持“情景总体中至少有 q 的比例能够达到这一削减量”的陈述。样本量不足时标记为不可估计，而不是赋值为零。受限 NA 优化将可用信息相同的决策耦合，并报告有限情景集合上的经验边界。与之对应的描述性 PI 比较采用相同的允许失败次数，但不替代总体容忍下界计算。

new.en: The PI programme maximised R separately for each scenario. We summarised these maxima using an exact-binomial nonparametric tolerance lower bound at reliability 0.95 and confidence 0.95.<sup>31</sup> With 100 scenarios, the second-smallest optimum supported this statement with achieved confidence 0.96292. The selected controller offers were independently tested using one-sided 95% Wilson probability lower bounds;<sup>32,33</sup> qualification required a lower bound of at least 0.95. This probability concerns all delivery and service criteria together.
new.zh: PI 程序分别最大化各情景的 R，再用可靠性 0.95、置信度 0.95 的精确二项非参数容忍下界汇总。<sup>31</sup> 在 100 个情景下，第二小的最优值以实际 0.96292 的置信度支持该陈述。所选控制器承诺采用单侧 95% Wilson 概率下界独立检验，<sup>32,33</sup> 资格要求下界至少 0.95。这项概率对应所有交付与服务标准同时满足。

old.en: The causal implementation was a robust model-predictive controller. It observed released jobs, the current queue, a 6-h community forecast and response requests within the notice window. No reinforcement learning or controller training was used. A predeclared 10-iteration binary search selected capacity on validation episodes for each duration, notice and reliability target. The search covered 0–100% of the reference reduction range. Controller configuration, code and scenario hashes were recorded, and any mismatch blocked locked evaluation. Certification required the one-sided 95% Wilson lower confidence bound on success in 500 locked in-distribution episodes to reach q.<sup>32,33</sup> This was a per-case criterion; simultaneous coverage of the full capacity surface was not claimed.
old.zh: 因果实现采用稳健模型预测控制器。它可以观测已释放作业、当前队列、未来 6 h 的社区预测，以及进入提前通知窗口的响应请求。研究没有使用强化学习或控制器训练。针对每种时长、提前通知和可靠性目标，在验证回合上进行预先声明的 10 次迭代二分搜索来选择容量，搜索范围覆盖参考削减区间的 0%–100%。控制器配置、代码和情景哈希均被记录，任何不一致都会阻止锁定评估。认证要求：500 个锁定同分布回合的成功率，其单侧 95% Wilson 置信下界达到 q。<sup>32,33</sup> 这是针对每种情形的标准，并未声称整个容量曲面具有同时置信覆盖。

new.en: The causal controller retained the six-hour robust MPC, historical-arrival uncertainty envelope and objective weights of the earlier implementation. It observed only released jobs, current queue state and the declared forecast. Its event cap required at least 95% delivery. Because the rebound criterion divides recovery overshoot by actual peak delivered power, the corrected recovery cap used 0.25 × 0.95 × requested power rather than 0.25 × requested power. Continuous actions were rounded towards the feasible side when converted to float32. This electrical cap does not guarantee deadline feasibility. Candidates at 50%, 75%, 90% and 100% of the development PI lower bound were evaluated separately; no monotonicity between candidates was assumed.
new.zh: 因果控制器保留此前实现中的六小时鲁棒 MPC、历史到达量不确定性包络和目标权重，只观察已释放作业、当前队列状态及声明的预测。事件功率上限要求至少交付 95%。由于反弹指标以实际最大削减功率为分母，修正后的恢复上限采用 0.25 × 0.95 × 承诺功率，而非 0.25 × 承诺功率。连续动作转换为 float32 时向可行一侧舍入。这项电气上限不保证截止时间可行性。开发 PI 下界的 50%、75%、90% 和 100% 候选分别接受检验，不假定候选之间具有单调性。

old.en: The initial diagnostic repeated fixed planning requests of 44.00 and 41.19 kW. A later, separately specified extension repeated the previously certified single-event offers of 39.65 and 36.71 kW for 4 and 8 h. Four calls began at hour 63, with gaps of 2, 4, 8, 12 or 24 h and zero notice. Development used 100 new seeds (900,000–900,099) and tested fractions {0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.90, 1.00} of each offer. For each duration–gap programme, we selected the largest tested fraction whose one-sided 95% Wilson lower bound reached 0.95. Original offers and positive selected candidates were then fixed for 300 new confirmation seeds (910,000–910,299). No positive selection was reported when every tested fraction failed the development rule.
old.zh: 最初的诊断实验重复调用 44.00 和 41.19 kW 的固定规划请求。随后另行规定的扩展研究，重复调用已获得单次认证的 39.65 和 36.71 kW 承诺，对应 4 和 8 h。四次调用从第 63 小时开始，间隔为 2、4、8、12 或 24 h，均无提前通知。开发阶段使用 100 个新种子（900,000–900,099），检验原承诺的 {0.25、0.50、0.75、0.90、1.00} 倍。对每个时长—间隔方案，选择单侧 95% Wilson 下界达到 0.95 的最大已测试比例。随后固定原承诺和选中的正容量候选，在 300 个新确认种子（910,000–910,299）上检验。如果所有比例均未满足开发阶段规则，就不报告正容量候选。

new.en: Repeated programmes comprised four four-hour calls with eight-hour gaps, or four eight-hour calls with twelve-hour gaps, starting at hour 63. For each workload configuration, development tested 25%, 50%, 75% and 100% of its selected single-event offer. The rule selected the largest qualifying candidate, if any, for independent confirmation. Regardless of that selection outcome, the original single-event offer was prespecified as a repeated-programme comparator and independently tested. The two programmes do not exhaust possible dispatch schedules.
new.zh: 重复方案由四次四小时调用、间隔八小时，或四次八小时调用、间隔十二小时组成，首次均从第 63 小时开始。各配置在开发阶段检验已选单次承诺的 25%、50%、75%、100%；若有候选通过，则选择最大者独立确认。无论该选值结果如何，原单次承诺均被预设为重复方案的对照并接受独立检验。这两个方案未穷尽所有调度安排。

old.en: Each original-offer event had a same-seed, same-clock fresh counterfactual with all other calls removed. The comparison of complete repeated and fresh programmes required all four calls to pass, preventing the four-call requirement itself from being mistaken for a history effect. Wilson bounds were pointwise; paired uncertainty resampled complete scenario seeds. A separate paired sensitivity continued arrivals for two additional days without changing the first seven days or call times. Supplementary Methods 10 describes the predictive models and production-timing stress.
old.zh: 原容量下的每个事件，都有同一种子、同一时刻且移除所有其他调用的新事件反事实。比较完整的连续调用与新事件组合时，两者都要求四次调用全部通过，避免把“四次都要成功”这一要求本身误认为历史调用的影响。Wilson 下界是逐条件的；配对不确定性按完整情景种子重采样。另一项配对敏感性分析保持前七天和调用时刻不变，将新增作业延续两天。补充方法 10 说明预测模型和生产到达时序检验。

new.en: Matched fresh counterfactuals removed all other calls while preserving the same seed, jobs, community trajectory and clock time. Both the repeated programme and the combination of fresh runs required all four calls to pass. Paired success differences resampled 300 complete scenario seeds 10,000 times. Each complete controlled trajectory was paired with its own no-response baseline for queue, service and economic calculations. Earlier ten-schedule, production-timing and horizon interventions remain separately labelled historical analyses in the archived v0.19 Supplementary Information.
new.zh: 配对的新事件反事实删除其余调用，同时保持种子、作业、社区轨迹和时刻相同。重复方案与新事件运行的组合都要求四次全部通过。成功率的配对差异对 300 个完整情景种子重采样 10,000 次。每条完整受控轨迹均与自身的无响应基准配对，用于队列、服务和经济核算。此前十种调用安排、生产时序及运行期干预在归档的 v0.19 补充材料中单独标明为历史分析。

old.en: with imports capped at 1,000 kW and exports prohibited. The hosting programme fixed data-centre capacity and maximised PV nameplate capacity. Available PV generation was the profile multiplied by nameplate capacity; curtailment was available minus used energy. The headline curtailment allowance was 5%, with 0%, 10% and 20% sensitivities. Full-information scheduling allowed at most 1% missed GPU-hours and 2% terminal backlog. BESS provided 100-kW charge/discharge power and 200-kWh energy, with 0.95 charge and discharge efficiencies and initial and terminal charge states of 50%. A mixed-integer formulation prohibited simultaneous charging and discharging. All-scenario hosting was the minimum scenario capacity and was reported only if every scenario was feasible; otherwise, feasible counts and scenario-wise ranges were reported.
old.zh: 进口功率上限为 1,000 kW，禁止向外反送电。接纳容量优化固定数据中心容量，并最大化光伏铭牌容量。可用光伏发电量为发电曲线乘以铭牌容量；弃光量为可用电量减去实际使用电量。主要弃光允许比例为 5%，另测试 0%、10% 和 20%。完全信息调度允许至多 1% 的 GPU-h 超期和 2% 的终端积压。电池储能具有 100 kW 充放电功率和 200 kWh 能量容量，充电与放电效率均为 0.95，初始及终端荷电状态均为 50%。混合整数形式禁止同时充电与放电。全情景接纳容量取各情景容量的最小值，并仅在每个情景均可行时报告；否则报告可行情景数和各情景容量范围。

new.en: with imports capped at 1,100 kW and exports prohibited. For each scenario we fixed the GPU installation and maximised PV nameplate subject to at most 5% curtailment, zero missed GPU-hours and at most 2% terminal backlog. BESS supplied 100-kW charge/discharge power and 200-kWh energy, with 0.95 charge and discharge efficiencies and initial and terminal state of charge of 50%. A mixed-integer formulation prohibited simultaneous charging and discharging. All-scenario hosting was the minimum scenario capacity, reported only if every scenario was feasible.
new.zh: 其中进口功率限制为 1,100 kW，并禁止反向送电。对每个情景，我们固定 GPU 设施规模，在弃光不超过 5%、未按期完成工作为零、末期积压不超过 2% 的条件下最大化光伏额定容量。储能充放电功率为 100 kW、容量为 200 kWh，充电和放电效率均为 0.95，初始与末期荷电状态均为 50%。混合整数公式禁止同时充放电。全情景光伏承载容量取各情景容量的最小值，且仅在所有情景均可行时报告。

old.en: The utilisation programme fixed the data centre at 201 kW and PV at 500 kW. Its lexicographic objective first preserved workload-service feasibility and then maximised local PV use within a 10<sup>−5</sup>-kWh objective tolerance. We measured PV use and curtailment, utilisation, renewable demand share, grid import, PCC peak and battery throughput. A separate 2 × 2 × 2 design maximised data-centre hosting with workload flexibility, PV and BESS each on or off. Predeclared difference-in-differences contrasts quantified resource interactions. HiGHS<sup>34</sup> used one solver thread per process, with scenario programmes parallelised externally. A post-run sensitivity repeated reference-scale hosting and utilisation with zero deadline misses in all 100 development and 100 validation scenarios, under both BESS conditions. Flexible cases were re-solved; rigid results were reused only after verifying hashes and zero misses.
old.zh: 利用率优化固定数据中心为 201 kW、光伏为 500 kW。其字典序目标首先保持工作负载服务可行性，再在 10<sup>−5</sup> kWh 的目标容差内最大化本地光伏利用。测量指标包括光伏使用量与弃光量、利用率、可再生能源需求占比、电网进口电量、公共连接点峰值及电池吞吐量。另一项 2 × 2 × 2 设计分别打开或关闭工作负载灵活性、光伏和储能，以最大化数据中心接纳容量。预先声明的双重差分对比用于量化资源交互作用。HiGHS<sup>34</sup> 在每个进程中使用一个求解线程，情景优化在求解器外部并行。事后敏感性分析在全部 100 个开发情景和 100 个验证情景中、两种储能条件下，以零超期要求重新评估参考规模的接纳容量和利用率。灵活情形重新求解；刚性结果仅在验证哈希和零超期后复用。

new.en: The utilisation programme fixed PV at 500 kW and retained each configuration's own data-centre power model. Its lexicographic objective first preserved service feasibility and then maximised local PV use within a 10<sup>−5</sup>-kWh tolerance, followed by grid-import and battery-throughput objectives. Rigid and flexible operation were paired under both BESS conditions on the first 100 confirmation seeds. Mean utilisation contrasts used 10,000 paired bootstrap resamples and pointwise 95% intervals. HiGHS<sup>34</sup> used one thread per solve, with independent scenarios parallelised externally. Storage problems retained HiGHS 1.15.1 default relative MIP gap 10<sup>−4</sup> and absolute gap 10<sup>−6</sup>. The 10<sup>−5</sup>-kWh lexicographic lock is not the MIP optimality tolerance. Utilisation contrasts near the roughly 0.01-percentage-point scale associated with that relative gap are not interpreted as resolved storage benefits; paired sampling intervals exclude optimisation uncertainty.
new.zh: 利用率优化将光伏固定为 500 kW，并保留每种配置自身的数据中心功率模型。词典序目标先保持服务可行，再在 10<sup>−5</sup> kWh 容差内最大化本地光伏利用，之后优化电网进口和电池吞吐量。在前 100 个确认种子上，有/无储能两种条件下的刚性与灵活运行均配对比较。平均利用率差异使用 10,000 次配对自助重采样和逐项 95% 区间。HiGHS<sup>34</sup> 每次求解使用一个线程，并在不同情景之间并行。 储能问题保留 HiGHS 1.15.1 的默认相对 MIP 间隙 10<sup>−4</sup> 和绝对间隙 10<sup>−6</sup>。10<sup>−5</sup> kWh 的词典序锁定不等于 MIP 最优性容差。接近该相对间隙对应的约 0.01 个百分点尺度的利用率差异，不解释为已分辨的储能条件下收益；配对抽样区间不包含优化不确定性。

old.en: Economic screening used the full independently certified capacities at 95% reliability and zero notice for 2-, 4- and 8-h events. The certificate-pinned controller and a no-response controller were replayed on the same 100 non-locked validation scenarios per duration, without reopening locked scenario payloads or reselecting capacity. Paired hourly trajectories supplied energy, delay and service costs from event start through the episode-end clearance tail. Performance revenue used non-negative PCC reduction capped in each interval at the offered obligation. Offers were restricted to \(K_{\mathrm{offer}}\in\{0,K_{\mathrm{cert}}\}\), excluding uncertified fractional offers. Annual net value was
old.zh: 经济性筛选采用 95% 可靠性、零提前通知下，2、4 和 8 h 事件完整的独立认证容量。每个时长均在相同的 100 个非锁定验证情景上，回放证书绑定的控制器与不响应控制器；不重新读取锁定情景载荷，也不重新选择容量。配对小时轨迹从事件开始持续至整个回合末的清空尾段结束，用于核算能耗、延迟和服务成本。执行收入按公共连接点非负削减量计算，且每个区间不超过报价义务。报价限制为 \(K_{\mathrm{offer}}\in\{0,K_{\mathrm{cert}}\}\)，不纳入未经认证的部分容量报价。年度净价值为

new.en: Economic screening used each configuration's development-selected, independently tested four- or eight-hour zero-notice offer. Controlled and no-response trajectories supplied paired energy, delay, deferred work and service outcomes from the first call through the 48-h clearance tail. Performance revenue used non-negative PCC reduction capped at the offer in each event hour. Annual net value retained the following accounting structure; inactive or unmeasured terms were stated explicitly rather than inferred from the hardware measurements:
new.zh: 经济筛选使用各配置在开发阶段选出、经独立检验的四小时或八小时零通知承诺。受控与无响应轨迹从首次调用开始，一直覆盖至 48 小时清空尾段结束，提供配对的能耗、延迟、推迟工作量及服务结果。履约收入按事件各小时非负的 PCC 削减量计算，并以上报承诺为限。年度净值保留下述核算结构；未启用或未测量的项目明确声明，而不从硬件测量中推断：

old.en: At the reference performance payment of US$50 per MWh, we solved for the capacity payment making net value zero. The risk-adjusted rule required the fifth percentile of 200 bootstrap annualisations to be non-negative. This percentile was a decision statistic, not a confidence interval. Natural-slack participation incurred no reserve or displacement charge. Reserved-headroom participation annualised capital per abstract PCC-side offered kilowatt. The displacement mode priced an assumed exposure at \(v_{\mathrm{eff}}=\alpha v_{\mathrm{GPUh}}\), separately from the cost of delaying work. The Supplementary Information defines each ledger term and its active or zero-valued assumptions.
old.zh: 在参考执行补偿为 50 美元/MWh 时，求解使净价值为零的容量补偿。风险调整规则要求 200 次自助法年化结果的第 5 百分位不小于零。该百分位是决策统计量，而非置信区间。自然余量参与不计预留或计算挤占费用。预留算力参与按公共连接点侧每个抽象报价千瓦对资本成本进行年化。计算挤占模式以 \(v_{\mathrm{eff}}=\alpha v_{\mathrm{GPUh}}\) 为假定风险定价，并与推迟工作的成本分开核算。补充信息定义了各账本项目及其启用或取零的假设。

new.en: Reference prices were US$50 per MWh of capped delivered energy, US$0.10 per kWh of incremental electricity and US$0.005 per GPU-h per hour of additional waiting. We solved for the capacity payment making the fifth percentile of 2,000 bootstrap annual net values non-negative. This was a decision statistic, not a confidence interval. Natural-slack participation incurred no reserve or displacement charge. The reserve case annualised 0.15 abstract reserved PCC-side kW per offered kW at US$2,500 per reserved kW, four-year life, 8% discount, 10% salvage and 3% annual operation and maintenance. The displacement case added an assumed US$0.25 per deferred GPU-h; this exposure was distinct from delay cost and was not a measured revenue loss. Connection benefits and checkpoint costs were unpriced; the reference missed-work price was zero. Existing-GPU depreciation was not inferred as an incremental response cost, and the reserve-capital scenario did not model wear or ageing.
new.zh: 参考价格为：封顶后的交付电量每 MWh 50 美元，增量用电每 kWh 0.10 美元，额外等待每 GPU 小时每小时 0.005 美元。我们求使 2,000 次自助抽样年度净值的第 5 百分位不为负的容量补偿。这是决策统计量，而非置信区间。自然空闲参与不计预留或挤占收费。预留情景按每千瓦承诺对应 0.15 个抽象 PCC 侧预留千瓦进行年化：每预留千瓦投资 2,500 美元、寿命四年、折现率 8%、残值 10%、年运维 3%。挤占情景增加每推迟 GPU 小时 0.25 美元的假定价值暴露；这与延迟成本不同，也不是实测收入损失。 接入收益与检查点成本未定价，参考未完成工作价格为零。没有将既有 GPU 折旧推断为增量响应成本，预留资本情景也不模拟磨损或老化。

old.en: Reference values were US$25,000 per year fixed and zero variable cost. Scaling the 201.001-kW reference ledger to 0.2, 1, 5 and 20 MW multiplied offered capacity and physical quantities together, applying the site charge once and assuming no diversification. This was accounting replication, not certification of a scaled facility. Reserve-capital life varied from three to six years at 8% discount and 10% salvage, with further financial sensitivities. Public accounting, financing, controls and market sources anchored ranges or provided product-specific comparisons, rather than measured operator costs.<sup>35–40</sup> Annual exposures of 1, 12 and 50 calls assumed independent fresh events; 100 and 250 calls were exposure stress tests, not forecasts of continuous programmes.
old.zh: 参考值为每年固定费用 25,000 美元、可变费用为零。将 201.001 kW 参考账本扩展到 0.2、1、5 和 20 MW 时，报价容量和物理量一起按比例缩放，场站费用只计一次，并假定不存在分散化效应。这是核算复制，不是对扩展设施的技术认证。预留资产经济寿命在三至六年间变化，贴现率为 8%、残值率为 10%，并另设财务敏感性。公开的会计、融资、控制系统和市场资料用于锚定范围或提供特定产品比较，而非作为运营者的实测成本。<sup>35–40</sup> 每年 1、12 和 50 次调用假定为相互独立的新鲜事件；100 和 250 次调用是暴露次数压力测试，而非连续项目预测。

new.en: The fixed site charge was US$25,000 per year and the variable enablement charge was zero. For 1-MW accounting, offered power and physical ledger quantities were multiplied by 1000 divided by the configuration's own operating peak, with the fixed charge applied once and no diversification assumed. This does not certify a 1-MW installation. Annual draws sampled 50 independent single events or 12 independent complete four-call series, retaining failed trajectories. Reserve life, delay price, displaced-value exposure, missed-work price and fixed site cost were sensitivity inputs, not operator estimates. The original external-source register<sup>35–40</sup> provides context for financial ranges, not validation of these scenario prices.
new.zh: 站点固定费用为每年 25,000 美元，可变启用费用为零。在 1 MW 会计尺度下，将承诺功率与物理账本量同乘以“1000 除以该配置自身运行峰值”，固定费用仅计一次，且不假定风险分散。这不构成对 1 MW 设施的认证。年度抽样选择 50 个独立单次事件，或 12 个独立完整四调用序列，并保留失败轨迹。预留寿命、延迟价格、挤占价值暴露、未完成工作价格和站点固定成本均为敏感性输入，而非运营商估计。原外部来源登记表<sup>35–40</sup> 为财务范围提供背景，并不验证这些情景价格。

old.en: The repeated-programme screen used only positive development-selected offers that passed confirmation. For each of 300 confirmation episodes per programme, one paired no-response ledger ran from the first call through episode termination. We used the same energy, delay, performance and fixed-site prices as the reference slack case. Two thousand annual draws sampled one or twelve complete series, retaining all episodes including failures, and applied the site charge once. Missed-work prices of US$0, 0.25 and 1 per GPU-h were a separate hypothetical sensitivity. Contract-specific failure penalties were not priced. This extension qualified its fractional offers separately and did not alter the original single-event offer set.
old.zh: 连续方案的经济筛查只使用在开发阶段选出、并通过确认的正容量承诺。每个方案的 300 个确认情景，各有一份从首次调用到情景终止的配对无响应账本。电价、延迟价格、性能支付和固定站点成本沿用参考自然余量情景。两千次年度抽样每次抽取一个或十二个完整序列，保留包括失败在内的全部情景，站点费用只计一次。每 GPU-h 0、0.25 和 1 美元的未完成工作价格是单独的假设性敏感性分析。未对具体合同的失败罚款定价。扩展研究对这些比例容量另行认证，没有改变原单次事件的承诺集合。

new.en: Repeated-programme costs were accumulated once per hour over the complete paired series. A programme that did not qualify was identified as such; its conditional cost did not create an eligible offer. Prices of US$0, 0.25 and 1 per missed GPU-h were separately evaluated, and contract-specific non-performance penalties were not priced. Independent annual draws do not reproduce a continuously operating year.
new.zh: 重复方案的成本沿完整配对序列逐小时累计，每小时只计一次。未通过资格检验的方案予以明确标识，其条件性成本不产生合格承诺。未完成工作每 GPU 小时 0、0.25 和 1 美元的价格单独评估，合同特定的不履约罚金未定价。独立年度抽样不复现全年连续运行。

old.en: Technical sensitivities varied hardware power, arrival intensity, rigid utilisation, deadline slack, success criteria, PUE and node overhead on 100 paired development seeds. Community comparisons held jobs, hardware, events and random streams fixed across 3A, 3C and 5A profiles. The share study fixed 576 GPUs and 374.4 GPU-h/h of offered work, making training eligible before offline inference. Its earlier 19 constructible configurations were followed by a 54-cell joint grid of 10–60% deferrable work and 10–90% flexible GPU allocation. Retaining earlier curves gave 64 distinct configurations, of which 32 passed the no-response service gate. Failed structural or service checks were retained as feasibility boundaries. Validation PI covered six durations; development results at 4 and 8 h fixed requests for paired 0-, 2- and 6-h-notice comparisons (Supplementary Methods 9).
old.zh: 技术敏感性分析在 100 个配对开发种子上改变硬件功率、到达强度、刚性利用率、期限余量、成功判据、PUE 和节点开销。社区比较在 3A、3C 和 5A 剖面之间保持作业、硬件、事件与随机流不变。比例分析固定 576 块 GPU 和每小时 374.4 GPU-h 的总工作量，先允许训练任务延后，再允许离线推理延后。早期 19 个可构造配置之后，又补充了覆盖 10–60% 可延后工作和 10–90% 灵活 GPU 分配的 54 格联合网格。保留早期曲线后，共有 64 个不同配置，其中 32 个通过无响应服务门槛。未通过结构或服务检查的配置保留为可行性边界。验证集的 PI 计算覆盖六个时长；开发集 4 和 8 h 的结果固定了配对比较 0、2 和 6 h 提前通知时使用的请求（补充方法 9）。

new.en: The five eligibility scenarios used a declared matching rule for GPU allocation and therefore are not a one-factor experiment across the whole range. Two additional controls kept 10% eligibility and the same jobs while assigning 20% or 30% of GPUs to the flexible pool. Two further controls changed only the unmeasured rigid-class active-power proxy to 150 or 225 W. Each control repeated PI planning, the same development-selected fixed requests, PV analysis and economic accounting. Confirmation never retuned the controller or selected new offers for these controls. Earlier broader parameter, regional and joint-share studies are retained with their original workload scope in the archived v0.19 Supplementary Information.
new.zh: 五档资格情景采用声明的 GPU 匹配分配规则，因此整个范围并不是单因素实验。两个额外对照保持 10% 资格和相同作业，只将 20% 或 30% 的 GPU 分配给灵活池。另两个对照只将未测刚性类别的活动功率代理改为 150 W 或 225 W。每项对照均重做 PI 规划、相同开发承诺的固定请求测试、光伏分析和经济核算。确认阶段不重新调节控制器，也不为这些对照选择新承诺。此前范围更广的参数、地域和联合比例研究在归档的 v0.19 补充材料中按其原始工作负载范围保留。

old.en: Post-hoc economic sensitivities crossed delay prices and fixed site costs using the existing validation ledger and common annual draws, and tested larger draw counts. They did not change the physical trajectories or locked selection. A supplementary recovery diagnostic divided event-end paired backlog debt by the recovery target and execution efficiency, then rounded the throughput-equivalent GPU count to four-GPU nodes. Its power conversion used the calibrated board-power artifact with assumed overhead and PUE. The result described equivalent recovery throughput, not a procurement requirement or a comparison across GPU generations.
old.zh: 事后经济敏感性复用现有验证账本和共同的年化抽样，交叉改变延迟价格与场站固定成本，并测试更多抽样次数。它们没有改变物理轨迹或锁定容量选择。一项补充恢复诊断将事件结束时的配对积压债务除以恢复目标时间和执行效率，再把吞吐等效 GPU 数向上取整为四 GPU 节点。其功率换算采用校准板卡功率，并假定额外开销和 PUE。结果描述的是等效恢复吞吐能力，不是购置需求，也不是不同 GPU 代际之间的比较。

new.en: Economic sensitivities recomputed payments from the fixed paired ledgers with common annual draws, without changing physical trajectories or offer selection. They crossed delay prices, site costs and assumed displaced-compute values, and separately varied missed-work prices. Hardware procurement, actual online-service costs and a continuous-year market simulation were not inferred from these screens.
new.zh: 经济敏感性分析使用固定配对账本和共同年度抽样重新计算补偿，不改变物理轨迹或承诺选择。分析交叉变化延迟价格、站点成本和假定挤占算力价值，并单独变化未完成工作价格。这些筛选不用于推断硬件采购、实际在线服务成本或全年连续市场运行。

old.en: Scenarios or complete episodes were the independent units for planning, controller and renewable analyses. Hardware uncertainty used independent run means. Renewable contrasts used 10,000 paired scenario-bootstrap resamples with Bonferroni familywise 95% intervals; interaction labels used a ±10.05-kW practical margin. Eligibility and GPU-allocation contrasts used paired t intervals with Bonferroni correction; notice success contrasts used exact McNemar tests with Holm correction. PI tolerance limits and Wilson lower bounds were pointwise. Controller certification used one-sided Wilson lower bounds, and economic risk adjustment used the annualisation percentile described above. Protocol, scenario, calibration, solver, controller and source hashes linked outputs to the frozen inputs. Verification used Python 3.12.13 and dependencies pinned in the lock file; Source Data manifests link figure values to the corresponding records.
old.zh: 场景或完整事件段是规划、控制器和可再生能源分析的独立单位，硬件不确定性则以独立运行均值为单位。可再生能源对比使用 10,000 次配对场景自助重采样以及 Bonferroni 家族范围 95% 区间；交互作用标签采用 ±10.05 kW 的实际意义阈值。可推迟比例和 GPU 分配对比采用 Bonferroni 校正的配对 t 区间；通知成功率对比采用 Holm 校正的精确 McNemar 检验。PI 容忍限和 Wilson 下界均为逐点统计量。控制器认证使用单侧 Wilson 下界，经济风险调整采用上述年度化百分位数。协议、场景、校准、求解器、控制器和源数据哈希将输出与冻结输入关联起来。核验使用 Python 3.12.13 和锁文件固定的依赖；源数据清单将图中数值连接到相应记录。

new.en: Independent scenarios were the statistical units; multiple calls within a scenario were not independent replicates. PI lower tolerance limits, Wilson probability lower bounds and paired bootstrap intervals were pointwise. Notice comparisons used exact paired McNemar tests with Holm correction across the 20 comparisons. Hardware intervals retained the original independent-run analysis. Source Data contain per-scenario outcomes, development selection tables, complete paired ledgers and ready-to-plot summaries; hashes link them to the source, protocol and controller versions.
new.zh: 独立情景是统计单位，同一情景中的多次调用不视为独立重复。PI 容忍下界、Wilson 概率下界及配对自助法区间均为逐项区间。通知比较采用配对精确 McNemar 检验，并对 20 项比较进行 Holm 校正。硬件区间保留原独立运行分析。源数据包含逐情景结果、开发选值表、完整配对账本和可直接绘图的汇总，哈希将其与来源、协议和控制器版本关联。

new.en: **a,** Flexible-minus-rigid all-scenario PV hosting gain at at most 5% curtailment. Each boundary is the minimum of 100 scenario capacities; the plotted difference of minima is not a mean effect and has no sampling-error bar. **b,** Mean paired change in PV utilisation for a fixed 500-kW installation, in percentage points, with pointwise 95% intervals from 10,000 paired bootstrap resamples of 100 scenario seeds. Sampling intervals exclude optimisation uncertainty; small signed BESS differences near the relative MIP-gap scale are not resolved benefits or physical losses. Both panels retain the actual power model at fixed GPU count, zero deadline misses and the common 1,100-kW import limit. BESS has 100-kW power and 200-kWh energy. These are full-information planning outcomes, separate from causal-controller qualification.

old.en: **a**, Risk-adjusted break-even capacity payment for the four-hour q = 0.95 certificate under slack-backed, reserved-headroom and throughput-displacing participation at proportional 0.2-, 1-, 5- and 20-MW accounting scales. Each mode is shown excluding the declared fixed site-enablement cost and including it as an operator-decision overlay. Scaled kilowatts are proportional reference-module accounting quantities, not technical certificates for the larger facilities. **b**, Mechanism sensitivities at the 1-MW accounting scale: annual fresh-event count for slack-backed response, economic life for reserved headroom and effective displaced-compute value \(\alpha v_{\mathrm{GPUh}}\) for throughput displacement. Event counts of 100 and 250 are labelled exposure-multiplier stress coordinates. **c**, Signed contributions to the four-hour risk-adjusted break-even payment. Positive values increase required compensation and negative values reduce it; zero-valued components are retained explicitly. The risk buffer is the residual between the mean and fifth-percentile rules. **d**, Mean break-even payment excluding fixed site cost and risk-adjusted payment including fixed site cost for independently certified 2-, 4- and 8-h reference-module capacities, shown at the 1-MW proportional accounting scale. The screen assumes independent fresh events, credits performance only up to the offered obligation and follows compute and energy through the episode-end clearance tail. Monetary inputs are parameterised research-design coordinates unless separately identified as external range anchors or product observations. Risk adjustment uses the fifth percentile of 200 annualisations drawn from 100 paired validation scenarios per duration; it is a decision rule, not a confidence interval. Source data are provided as a Source Data file.
old.zh: **a**，在 0.2-、1-、5- 和 20-MW 比例核算尺度下，四小时 q = 0.95 证书采用利用自然作业余量、预留容量余量和挤占计算吞吐量三种参与方式时，风险调整后的盈亏平衡容量补偿。每种方式均展示不含已声明站点固定接入成本的结果，以及将该成本作为运营商决策叠加项计入后的结果。按比例放大的千瓦数是参考模块的比例核算量，而非更大设施的技术容量证书。**b**，1-MW 核算尺度下的机制敏感性：利用自然作业余量响应的年度新事件次数、预留容量余量的经济寿命，以及挤占计算吞吐量的有效被挤占计算价值 \(\alpha v_{\mathrm{GPUh}}\)。事件次数 100 和 250 标记为暴露倍数压力测试坐标。**c**，对四小时风险调整后盈亏平衡补偿的有符号贡献。正值提高所需补偿，负值降低所需补偿；零值分项也明确保留。风险缓冲为均值规则与第五百分位数规则之间的差额。**d**，对于经独立认证的 2-h、4-h 和 8-h 参考模块容量，在 1-MW 比例核算尺度下展示不含站点固定成本的平均盈亏平衡补偿，以及包含站点固定成本的风险调整后补偿。该筛查假设各次事件均为相互独立、无先前调用历史的新事件，仅对不超过报价义务的响应交付计入履约收益，并将计算与能量跟踪至回合末的清空尾段。除非另行明确标识为外部范围锚点或产品观测值，货币输入均为参数化研究设计坐标。风险调整使用从每个时长的 100 个配对验证情景中抽取而成的 200 个年度化样本的第五百分位数；这是一项决策规则，而非置信区间。源数据以 Source Data 文件提供。

new.en: **a,b,** Required annual capacity payment per offered accounting kilowatt for four- and eight-hour single events, with 50 independently sampled calls per year. Existing slack, reserved headroom and an assumed US$0.25 per deferred GPU-h displaced-value exposure use the same physical ledger. **c,** Complete four-call programmes at 12 independent series per year: original single-event offers reused repeatedly, and smaller selected repeated offers when available. Filled circles mark passage of the pointwise confirmation criterion; crosses mark failure. None of the repeated offers was selected by the separate development rule. A conditional price does not alter either statistical outcome. **d,** Delay-price sensitivity at 10% eligibility. All panels use 1-MW proportional accounting, a US$25,000 annual site charge applied once, and 2,000 common annual draws. Thresholds make the fifth percentile of annual net value non-negative. Contract-specific failure penalties are unpriced; series independence does not simulate a continuous year.
new.zh: **a、b，**四小时与八小时单次事件每会计承诺千瓦所需的年度容量补偿，每年独立抽样 50 次。现有空闲、预留容量，以及每推迟 GPU 小时假设 0.25 美元挤占价值的情景使用同一物理账本。**c，**每年 12 个独立序列的完整四调用方案：重复使用原单次承诺，以及有候选时采用较小已选重复承诺。实心圆表示通过逐项确认标准，叉号表示未通过。重复承诺均未通过另行开展的开发选值规则。条件价格不改变这两项统计结果。**d，**10% 资格下的延迟价格敏感性。各面板均采用 1 MW 比例会计尺度、每年仅计一次的 25,000 美元站点费用及 2,000 次共同年度抽样，门槛使年度净值的第 5 百分位不为负。合同特定失败罚金未定价；序列独立不等于连续全年模拟。
